article.articleHeadline: Garantizan insumos para el control de la malaria en municipios selváticos de Amazonas - MPPS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They guarantee supplies for malaria control in the jungle municipalities of Amazonas - MPPS
article.articleSummary: Malaria-control supplies and vaccines were distributed on Oct 24 to the jungle municipalities of Autana, Alto Orinoco, Atabapo, Manapiare, Maroa, and Río Negro in Amazonas state, Venezuela, to sustain malaria prevention, diagnosis and treatment in hard-to-reach communities. The joint operation by the State Health Directorate (DES Amazonas), the Ministry of Health (MinSalud), the Environmental Health Directorate (DESA), and the Malaria Elimination Program replenished rapid diagnostic tests, diagnostic materials, and antimalarial medicines, and provided resources to reinforce care in Río Negro and the Mavaca parish of Alto Orinoco with vaccines and immunization staff to broaden coverage. The effort strengthens coordination between environmental health teams and local health personnel, ensuring stocked diagnostic and treatment posts for timely malaria care in the most remote areas. Authority Joskany La Rosa, with backing from Governor Miguel Rodríguez, emphasizes ongoing commitment to sustaining health services for Amazonas families.

triage.headline_ja: アマソナス州のジャングル自治体へマラリア対策物資を保証 - MPPS
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラにおけるマラリア対策物資の定期的な配布に関するルーティン活動の報告であり、対象国（ベネズエラは対象国リストに含まれない）における新規発生や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: イベントはベネズエラ（アマソナス州）での通常のマラリア対策物資配布に関する内容。対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する国での発生ではないため、Brazilなど発生地域に含まれる国も記事の主題ではなく除外。

article.articleHeadline: How China Tracks COVID-19 Cases and Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 monitoring has shifted from zero-COVID mass testing to risk-based testing and routine respiratory surveillance. As of August 2026, China reported 771,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, 640 severe cases, and six deaths, noting these figures do not capture all infections. National guidance no longer mandates universal nucleic-acid screening; testing is guided by symptoms, exposure, setting, and risk, with weekly testing in elder-care and social-welfare facilities during outbreaks and prompt testing for fever or respiratory symptoms. China CDC's sentinel acute respiratory-infection system now includes SARS-CoV-2 in its panel, testing outpatient, emergency, and hospitalized patients for influenza-like illness and severe acute respiratory infection to track COVID-19 alongside other pathogens. The current framework relies on targeted testing and surveillance rather than widespread isolation, and historical zero-COVID rules (the 20 Measures and 10 Measures) should not be treated as current nationwide requirements.

triage.headline_ja: 中国はいかにしてCOVID-19の症例と流行を追跡しているか
triage.triage_reason: 中国の既存のCOVID-19サーベイランス体制を解説する一般的な記事であり、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国のサーベイランス制度・検査方針の解説であり、報告された症例数（771,000例、重症640例、死亡6例）も既存の監視体制内の通常報告データとして提示されている。新たなアウトブレイクや異常なクラスターの発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola makes a return
article.articleSummary: Ebola has returned to Nigeria after 14 years, linked to a Nigerian traveler, a woman whose identity is undisclosed. The disease, Ebola haemorrhagic fever, originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with a fearsome outbreak in the DRC ongoing for months. Unlike the 2014 Lagos import via a Liberian vectored Ebola, this instance is an imported case into Nigeria. The episode underscores that, had the index traveler’s passport history been carefully perused and established that she had been to Congo before travelling to Uganda, she would have been quarantined in Abuja before trouble reared its head. Now the country is scrambling to manage what it could have prevented. Some social media voices frame the return as a political ploy, but health authorities face an imported Ebola case requiring careful handling.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、再び発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの進行中のエボラ出血熱流行を背景に、ナイジェリアへの輸入症例が確認された。重篤な疾患であり、国境を越えた拡大・渡航制限のリスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアへのエボラ輸入症例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは進行中の流行の発生源として本文で実質的に言及されているため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダ・リベリアも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: En Mendoza piden reforzar la vacunación contra el sarampión ante la alerta sanitaria internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Mendoza, they call for strengthening measles vaccination amid the international health alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles risk in South America is deemed 'very high' by OPS as Argentina prepares for Pope León XIV's November visit. Between Jan 4 and Oct 3, 2026, 55,792 cases and 77 deaths were reported in 17 countries, 4.8-fold higher than 2025. Despite vaccination efforts, regional coverage remains uneven; OPS urges at least 95% two-dose MMR coverage. Argentina's first-dose coverage was 83.6% in 2025, second-dose 54.8%. Mendoza province shows 97.1% first dose and 91% second dose. Weekly alerts of suspected cases on flights linked to Brazil highlight cross-border risk. Measles is a highly contagious Morbillivirus spread by respiratory droplets; symptoms include fever, runny nose, conjunctivitis, cough, Koplik spots, and rash. Severe complications include pneumonia, encephalitis, seizures, blindness, and death. Vaccination is free at public centers; children born after July 1, 2024 receive first dose at 12 months and second at 15 months; adults born since 1965 should have two doses.

triage.headline_ja: メンドーサ、国際保健警報を受け麻疹ワクチン接種強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 南米で麻疹症例が前年比4.8倍に急増し、PAHO（OPS）が地域リスクを「非常に高い」と評価、国際的な保健警報が出されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン（メンドーサ州）における麻疹対策であり、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルは便を介した症例連絡の文脈でのみ言及され、ブラジル国内での発生が主題ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Four-year-old boy dies of dengue shock syndrome at CMCH
article.articleSummary: Four-year-old boy from Palladam, Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, died at Coimbatore Medical College Hospital (CMCH) after dengue fever progressed to dengue shock syndrome and sepsis with disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC). He was first brought to a private clinic on October 20 with fever; initial tests reportedly showed no significant abnormalities. He returned on October 21 for IV fluids, and again on October 22 for fever and vomiting, with a subsequent drop in platelet count. Seizures and circulatory failure followed; doctors found dengue positive and referred him to CMCH. Admitted at 1:18 am on October 23, he required intubation for respiratory failure and received resuscitation and blood products. He died in the evening after about 19 hours at CMCH. No infection source details or international import/export cases are noted.

triage.headline_ja: 4歳男児、コインバトール医科大学病院(CMCH)でデング熱ショック症候群により死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドで風土病であるデング熱による単発の重症死亡例報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報は確認できない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の死亡報告であり、地域的なアウトブレイクや異常な流行パターンを示す情報はない。デング熱はタミル・ナードゥ州を含むインドで季節的に流行する風土病であるため、通常の症例報告として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Balneário Camboriú reduz dengue em 2026 com Wolbachia, vacinas e fiscalização
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balneário Camboriú reduces dengue in 2026 with Wolbachia, vaccines, and enforcement.
article.articleSummary: Balneário Camboriú, Santa Catarina, Brazil, reports a 99.8% reduction in dengue cases—from 7,106 in 2024 to 12 by September 2026—driven by a mix of biotechnological control, enforcement, and vaccination. The core strategy releases Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes (Wolbitos) to block dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission; releases ran August 2025 for six months across four neighborhoods, via 52 coordinated actions over 26 weeks. Mosquitoes are produced by a Joinville biofactory, in partnership with Fiocruz and the Ministry of Health. Simultaneously, endemic-control teams conduct daily inspections to eliminate standing water and sanction irregular lots; Praia dos Amores saw 12 truckloads of debris removed from one abandoned property, with fumacê applied where infections were recently confirmed. Vaccination includes over 3,000 youths aged 10–16 receiving the first Qdenga dose, 1,357 completing the second. No dengue deaths since 2025; final impact awaits ongoing scientific assessment.

triage.headline_ja: バルネアリオ・カンボリウ市、ウォルバキア・ワクチン・取締りで2026年のデング熱を減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例数が99.8%減少という良好な成果を報告する内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念や異常事態ではなく、介入策の成功事例を伝える記事である。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱対策（ウォルバキア蚊放出、ワクチン接種、取締り）の成功事例を報告するポジティブな内容であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 2026年第四季度川渝地区传染病风险健康提示来了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Q4 2026 Infectious Disease Risk Health Tips for the Sichuan-Chongqing Region Have Arrived.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 October 2026, the Sichuan CDC and Chongqing CDC warn that Q4 brings cooler weather and larger diurnal temperature variation, increasing activity of influenza and varicella, with norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease also in season. Respiratory diseases: influenza presents with sudden high fever, headache, myalgia and fatigue; varicella with fever and centripetal red papules. High-risk groups include infants, the elderly, and those with chronic illnesses; vaccination is the most effective prevention, reinforced by hygiene, masking in crowded places, and regular indoor ventilation and disinfection. Gastrointestinal diseases: hand-foot-mouth causes fever and oral mucosal lesions with rash on hands, feet and buttocks; norovirus causes nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and diarrhea. Priority sites include schools, nurseries, eldercare facilities and catering services. EV71 vaccination should be completed before 12 months. Outbreaks require proper vomiting cleanup and reporting to disease control. October travel raises imported case risk; travelers with fever, rash, or joint pain within two weeks of return should seek care and disclose travel or bite history.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年第4四半期 四川・重慶地区 感染症リスク健康注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の定例health advisory（インフルエンザ、水痘、ノロウイルス、手足口病）であり、異常な発生や重症化の報告はなく、通常の予防啓発情報にとどまる。
triage.notes: 本記事は四川・重慶地区CDCによる季節性感染症の定例注意喚起であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Civic chief reviews dengue control measures as Pune reports 2,291 cases
article.articleSummary: Pune reports 2,291 dengue cases from January 1 to October 20, 2026, adding to 4,908 cases in 2024 and 2,391 in 2025. Municipal commissioner Naval Kishore Ram reviewed control measures and visited Dr Naidu Infectious Diseases Hospital to intensify prevention. An inspection drive covered 14 lakh homes; 2,831,386 water containers were checked, with Aedes larvae found in 18,885 containers across 13,000 homes. Notices were issued to 2,664 properties, with fines totaling ₹6.30 lakh. Private hospitals offer 4,409 beds (670 ICU); civic hospitals provide 333 beds (6 ICU). Dr Naidu Hospital has 50 dengue beds (35 vacant). Rapid diagnostic kits are available at all dispensaries; free confirmatory tests at Dr Naidu, Dr Kotnis, and Kamala Nehru hospitals. Dengue cases must be registered on the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP) to avoid duplicates. Targeted fogging, biological larvicides in stored water, and awareness campaigns via rail stations, radio, and garbage-vehicle announcements are in place.

triage.headline_ja: 市当局責任者がデング熱対策を見直し、プネーで2,291件の症例報告
triage.triage_reason: プネーでのデング熱は例年発生している季節性感染症であり、既存の対策体制下で管理されているため緊急のPICKUPには該当しないが、症例数の推移として注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はプネーで毎年発生する季節性疾患であり、2024年4,908件、2025年2,391件、2026年(10月時点)2,291件と前年並みの水準。市当局は積極的な予防策（蚊の発生源対策、検査体制強化、病床確保）を実施しており、管理体制は機能していると見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue có nguy cơ lan rộng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak at risk of spreading
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam, with 7 locally acquired cases in Ha Thanh Ward since Oct 16, 2026; 4 cases are in the Doi Cung 2 hamlet, showing possible secondary transmission. Thanh Hoa CDC surveillance on Oct 23 found breeding sites and Aedes mosquitoes in the area, signaling ongoing transmission risk. Authorities urge intensified information campaigns, diverse communication methods, and prompt medical evaluation for anyone with dengue-like fever; avoid self-treatment. Emphasis on vector control: environmental sanitation, removal of water-holding containers, larval source elimination, weekly cleanups, and clearing vegetation and drains around living areas. Plan to accelerate fall-winter 2026 mosquito control with insecticides per health ministry guidelines. Hospitals should maintain beds, medications, IV fluids, and infection control; prepare for admission and safe transfers; monitor for warning signs such as severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, unusual bleeding, or lethargy. Community and authorities must cooperate to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行、拡大のリスク
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・タインホア省での局地的なデング熱アウトブレイク（7例）で二次感染の可能性があるが、季節性のデング熱であり国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報は限定的なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: タインホア省ハタイン区での局地的流行で、地方当局が媒介蚊対策と医療体制強化を実施中。デング熱はベトナムで季節性・地方流行性の疾患であり、現時点で異常事態とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: PMC issues notices to Ruby Hall Clinic, Noble Hospital seeks explanations over dengue test records
article.articleSummary: In Pune, Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) issued notices on Oct 21 to Ruby Hall Clinic and Noble Hospital over dengue-reporting lapses and test-record discrepancies following a suspected dengue death of a nine-year-old girl (died Oct 18). Ruby Hall Clinic was asked to explain why the case was not reported to the vector-borne disease control department within the prescribed time and to submit the girl’s detailed laboratory report and a blood sample for re-examination by the National Institute of Virology (NIV). Noble Hospital was questioned about discrepancies between dengue screening results and the method recorded on the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP). Three patients — a 35-year-old man, a 3-year-old boy, and a 63-year-old woman — were screened with rapid NS1 tests while IHIP listed ELISA as the diagnostic method; Noble Hospital said the entry was a clerical error and corrected it. A 2016 government order caps NS1 ELISA and MAC-ELISA at ₹600 and prohibits rapid tests for definitive diagnosis; dengue became notifiable in 2016.

triage.headline_ja: PMCがルビー・ホール・クリニックとノーブル病院に通知、デング熱検査記録に関する説明を要求
triage.triage_reason: 個別病院における報告手続き・検査記録の不備に関する行政対応の記事であり、公衆衛生上の重大な異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はPune市における個別の病院（デング熱検査報告義務違反）への行政指導に関するものであり、Nipahウイルスについての言及はない。デング熱自体はインドで流行病として認識されているが、本記事は症例急増や異常な拡大を報じるものではなく、報告制度上の手続き問題が主題。

article.articleHeadline: 流行季提前，婴幼儿需警惕呼吸道合胞病毒！医生提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early RSV season: Infants and young children should be vigilant about Respiratory Syncytial Virus. Doctors remind.
article.articleSummary: Weather turns cooler and China enters an early Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) season. China CDC surveillance shows most regions remain at low levels with small fluctuations. RSV is highly contagious, spreading via droplets and contact, and is a leading cause of pneumonia and bronchiolitis in children under five; infants, especially those ≤2 years, preterm, or with congenital heart disease, face higher risk of severe disease. Infection can cause airway edema, increased secretions, wheeze, and, if untreated, hypoxia or respiratory failure; repeated infections may occur within a season. Early symptoms resemble a cold, so caregivers should seek care for persistent coughing or nighttime wheeze; signs of oxygen deprivation require urgent care. Antibiotics do not treat RSV, and most over-the-counter remedies do not kill the virus. Nebulization should be decided by clinicians, as some children may require hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: RSV流行期が前倒しに：乳幼児は呼吸器合胞体ウイルスに注意を、医師が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、サーベイランスでは大半の地域で低水準とされ、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: RSVは既知の季節性感染症であり、記事は一般的な注意喚起・予防啓発を目的とした内容。流行の前倒しが言及されているが、サーベイランス上は低水準と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Scrub typhus testing picks up amid seasonal infections
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus cases rise in Lucknow as clinicians test more due to symptom overlap with dengue and malaria. At King George's Medical University, 8–10 positives daily from 40–45 samples; overall >80 cases reported in Lucknow Jan 1–Oct 24, 2026, with peaks in June and September when vegetation is dense. Disease caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi and transmitted by infected chigger mites; mites inhabit grassy, vegetated areas, with humidity and post-monsoon vegetation increasing exposure risk. Symptoms include high fever, headache, and body aches; rash or eschar may appear but are not required. Delayed diagnosis can cause severe complications affecting lungs, kidneys, and other organs. Preventive measures include avoiding dense vegetation, protective clothing, repellents, keeping surroundings clean, and seeking care for persistent fever. India-wide cases rose from 32,364 (2022) to 86,895 (2025), with 10,861 more by Mar 6, 2026; scrub typhus is endemic in parts of Asia and the western Pacific.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性感染症の増加に伴いツツガムシ病の検査が増加
triage.triage_reason: インド・ラクナウにおける季節性のツツガムシ病（恙虫病）の検査増加に関する通常の公衆衛生報告であり、既知の流行パターンに沿い、人-人感染もなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はダニ媒介性で人-人感染なし。季節性パターン（6月・9月ピーク）に沿った既知の流行で、インド国内の医療機関が独自に対応している通常のサーベイランス事例。インド全体の年次症例数増加（2022年32,364件→2025年86,895件）は注目に値するが、今回の記事はラクナウでの検査体制強化が主題。

article.articleHeadline: കാവിലുംപാറയിൽ കുട്ടികൾക്ക്​ അഞ്ചാംപനി; ആ​റു​മാ​സം മു​ത​ൽ പ്രായമുള്ള കു​ട്ടി​ക​ൾ​ക്കാ​ണ്​ രോ​ഗം ബാ​ധി​ക്കു​ക: മുന്നറിയിപ്പുമായി ആരോഗ്യവകുപ്പ് | Kavilumpara Measles Outbreak: Infants Aged 6 Months Onward at Risk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kavilumpara Measles Outbreak: Infants Aged Six Months Onward at Risk; Health Department Warns.
article.articleSummary: Five primary-school students in Kavilumpara panchayat’s Paikkalanggadi area have measles, signaling an outbreak. Infants from six months of age remain at risk, especially unvaccinated children who have not received the first birthday immunization. Public health actions include door-to-door visits, fever surveys, immunization awareness drives, and ward sanitation committee meetings, led by health department officials and medical staff. Measles spreads through droplets and eye/nose secretions; about 90% of exposed individuals may contract the infection. Reported symptoms include fever, cough, conjunctivitis, diarrhea, and a facial-to-body rash that begins behind the ears around day four, with fever subsiding over time. Vomiting and dehydration can be fatal if not treated. Emphasis is on increasing vaccination coverage to prevent spread and protect vulnerable infants.

triage.headline_ja: カヴィルンパラ地域で麻疹流行：生後6か月以上の乳幼児がリスクに、保健局が警告
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州の一地区で学童5名の麻疹クラスターが発生し地域保健当局が対応中だが、現時点では小規模な局地的流行であり国際的拡大や重篤な転帰の報告はない。
triage.notes: 地元紙（マラヤーラム語）報道による局地的麻疹流行。未接種の乳幼児層への感染拡大リスクがあり、保健当局が戸別訪問・発熱調査・ワクチン接種啓発を実施中。続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virusunun "Bundibuqyo" ştammı diplomatın ailəsində aşkarlandı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus was detected in a diplomat's family.
article.articleSummary: 42-year-old Ugandan citizen living in Abuja, Nigeria, diagnosed with Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain. The infected woman is the wife of a Swiss diplomat; Swiss Foreign Ministry confirmed. Test results on Oct 20 were positive, with Ebola testing performed Oct 19 after initial malaria concerns and symptoms that emerged roughly 13 days earlier. Swiss officials believe the infection occurred during a visit to Uganda; exact source remains undetermined. The Swiss diplomatic mission in Nigeria continues operations; no staff infections reported. The current Ebola wave began in May in Congo, then spread to Uganda and Kenya; Congo has about 9,500 infections and over 4,600 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの「ブンディブギョ」株が外交官の家族から検出された
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のDRC発エボラ流行（約9,500感染・4,600死亡）に関連し、ナイジェリアで外交官家族にブンディブギョ株感染が確認された。国際的拡大・社会的関心ともに高く、IHR基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本件の症例診断地はナイジェリア（アブジャ）、感染源はウガンダ訪問時と推定されるが、両国は対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは現在進行中のエボラ流行の発生源・中心地として記事内で明示的に言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Extreme Male Skew in Xiamen's Notified HIV Cases Linked to MSM
article.articleSummary: Xiamen, southeastern China, exhibits one of the most male-skewed HIV/AIDS epidemics in national data. An open-access mixed-methods analysis of 2003–2025 city-level records (4,326 notified cases) reports 90.45% male and 9.55% female, overall male-to-female ratio 9.47:1, peaking at 18.19:1 in 2017. Across China 2010–2022, males comprised 78.84% of new diagnoses (15+), ratio 3.64:1. In Xiamen, MSM transmission emerged after 2007, accounting for 52.38% of cumulative cases. Excluding MSM lowers the ratio to 3.99:1, suggesting about two-thirds of the male excess relates to MSM. Spatial clustering hotspots are in central Siming and Huli Districts, linked to migrant MSM inflows. Qualitative interviews reveal underreporting due to concealment of same-sex behavior and screening gaps for high-risk women, with residual injection-drug transmission contributing. Findings support targeted local interventions in migrant coastal cities.

triage.headline_ja: 厦門市のHIV報告症例における極端な男性偏重はMSM感染と関連
triage.triage_reason: これは2003年から2025年までの長期疫学データに基づく学術研究報告であり、急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2003-2025年の既存データを分析した学術研究の紹介であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性のシグナルではない。HIV/MSM感染の既知の疫学パターンに関する知見であり、継続的なサーベイランス対象ではあるが緊急のRRA対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola di Kenya: Perempuan 65 Tahun Jadi Korban Meninggal Kedua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kenya: 65-Year-Old Woman Becomes the Second Fatality
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its second Ebola death in the country’s first outbreak, a 65-year-old woman who developed symptoms on October 13 while in quarantine and died early October 25, 2026. The toll rises to two, with seven other patients still under care in two isolation facilities. All confirmed cases are within a single cluster; health authorities report no evidence of community transmission. The first case involved a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Nairobi, falling ill in September and dying on October 5 in Nairobi. Current patients include three family members of the initial victim, three healthcare workers, and one hospital cleaner. The outbreak is linked to Ebola virus species Bundibugyo; there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment yet, though supportive care is provided. Kenya has intensified entry screening with digital health monitoring forms and QR code checks for travelers from high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ出血熱：65歳女性が2人目の死亡者に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症がケニア初のアウトブレイクとして発生し、死亡者が増加、医療従事者への感染や国際的な越境感染リスクがあるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 初発例はDRCからナイロビへの渡航者だが、発生（アウトブレイク）自体はケニアで起きており、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。DRCは感染源国として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での発生ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 三价流感疫苗"够用"吗 应对今年毒株有效
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the trivalent influenza vaccine "sufficient" to cope with this year's strains?
article.articleSummary: Vaccination timing and vaccine composition in China: influenza activity is rising in some regions as temperatures drop, with the best time to vaccinate now. China's CDC reports that since July, influenza A(H3N2) and influenza B Victoria lineage have co-circulated, with A(H3N2) increasing to dominate among A strains. The Oct 22 weekly surveillance shows positive samples: 66.1% influenza A and 33.9% influenza B; within A, 19.4% A(H1N1)pdm09 and 80.6% A(H3N2); all B viruses are Victoria lineage. The peak season in China typically runs from November to March. Protection from vaccination takes 2-4 weeks. Regarding vaccine composition, trivalent vaccines cover A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B Victoria; four-valent adds B/Yamagata, which has not been detected globally since March 2020; WHO recommends removing B/Yamagata. For 2026-2027, global vaccines are transitioning to trivalent; protection is similar between tri- and quad-valent vaccines in this context.

triage.headline_ja: 三価インフルエンザワクチンは「十分」か 今年の株に対応可能
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況とワクチン接種に関する一般的な公衆衛生情報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 通常の季節性インフルエンザサーベイランスとワクチン組成に関する報道であり、新規性・異常性のあるアウトブレイク情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Sexagenarian dies of suspected scrub typhus; Sundaragada CDMO denies claim
article.articleSummary: 63-year-old Harihar Patta of Ujjwalpur village, Tangarpali block, Sundaragada district, is suspected to have died of scrub typhus after an insect bite in his field. Sundaragada CDMO Dr Suresh Chandra Mohanty denies the claim, noting district headquarters hospital and Government Medical College records show no death attributed to scrub typhus. A health department team will visit Ujjwalpur on Sunday to investigate. Patta reportedly fell ill after the bite several days earlier; he was first taken to Sargipali health centre, then to the district headquarters hospital, and later transferred to a private hospital where he died on Friday afternoon. Family members and locals attribute the death to scrub typhus, but infection has not been laboratory confirmed. Authorities are reviewing records and awaiting investigation results amid ongoing local concern about scrub typhus in Sundaragada.

triage.headline_ja: 60代男性がツツガムシ病疑いで死亡、スンダラガダCDMOは否定
triage.triage_reason: 単発の死亡疑い事例で検査確定もされておらず、当局も死亡を否定している。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、社会的関心も地域限定的。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はベクター媒介性で人-人感染なし。単一の疑い症例であり、検査確認もされていない。Bangladeshは記事主題に含まれず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Test Of A Weak Health System
article.articleSummary: Ebola re-emerges in Nigeria: On Oct 25, 2026, a travel-related case in Abuja (from Uganda) triggers contact tracing of 44 close contacts; the incident management system with WHO, Africa CDC, and NCDC is activated. The patient showed no symptoms on arrival; symptoms appeared four days later, underscoring airport-screening gaps. The flare echoes 2014 Lagos, when a Liberian index case led to 20 cases and 8 deaths; vigilance by clinicians saved Nigeria then. Current threats arise from weakened health systems: healthcare worker shortages, under-resourced primary centres, and Abuja Declaration spending gaps (15% of budget). Regional context: DRC reports about 8,700 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,200 deaths (Bundibugyo strain, no licensed vaccine). The response urges hospitals nationwide to adopt clear case definitions, PPE, and rapid laboratory testing beyond Lagos/Abuja, protect and pay contacts, restore isolation centres, and publish daily updates to counter misinformation and stigma.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:脆弱な保健システムの試練
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち重大性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの3項目に該当し、ナイジェリアでの渡航関連エボラ症例再発によりWHO・Africa CDC・NCDCが対応を開始しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア(アブジャ/ラゴス)での渡航関連エボラ症例再発であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRCは地域的背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ заявили о расширении географии вспышки Эболы в Африке -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announced that the geographic scope of the Ebola outbreak has expanded in Africa — NIA "Khovar"
article.articleSummary: WHO Africa regional office reports expansion of the Ebola outbreak in Africa, with Kenya reporting rising cases, the Democratic Republic of Congo confirming a new eighth province affected, and Nigeria reporting its first case. By October 19, the outbreak reached 66 health zones across eight provinces in the DRC. Since October 11, 572 new confirmed cases and 265 deaths were recorded in the DRC, bringing the country's totals to 9,637 confirmed cases and 4,646 deaths (case fatality about 48.2%). Although September saw a decline, early October signs indicate renewed growth. Ongoing instability, population displacement, and limited access for humanitarian actors hinder surveillance and response. The information underscores the need for intensified outbreak control measures, cross-border collaboration, and support to strained health systems in affected African countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカにおけるエボラ流行の地理的拡大を発表 — NIA「ホヴァル」
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC内で拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWHOによる国際的関心の高まりが確認される。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの流行拡大と致死率の高さから優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: DOH reports rise in influenza-like illnesses, plans vaccine rollout
article.articleSummary: DOH reports rising influenza-like illnesses; Epidemiology Bureau tallies 11,137 cases in recent weeks, an 8% increase from 10,378 reported Sept. 3–16. Acting Secretary Edwin Mercado links the uptick to the cold season and year-end celebrations. An influenza virus vaccine will roll out next week, with a two-month vaccination campaign through December prioritizing seniors, preschool children, and people with pre-existing medical conditions. Cumulative influenza-like illness cases reach 122,514 for the year. COVID-19 cases rose to 291 in the week, up from 245, but DOH says they have not reached epidemic proportions, and current requirements do not yet mandate COVID-19 vaccination. Officials note most influenza-like illnesses are viral and not fatal; management focuses on rest, fluids, and nutrition.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、インフルエンザ様疾患の増加を報告、ワクチン接種展開を計画
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ様疾患とCOVID-19の軽度な増加が報告されているが、DOH自身が流行レベルには達していないとしており、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性の流行であり、DOHは流行レベルに達していないと明言。ワクチン接種キャンペーンは通常の予防対策として実施される。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, une autre bataille contre la peur et la stigmatisation face à Ebola (REPORTAGE)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, another battle against fear and stigma in the face of Ebola (REPORTAGE)
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to provoke fear and stigma. In Bunia, Ituri Province, psychosocial care is integrated in Ebola treatment centers to help terrified patients accept isolation, understand procedures, and stay in care. As of 20 October, the DRC reported 9,704 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,687 deaths across eight provinces, with Ituri the most affected. Burial practices and community fears also hinder response, including a secure burial in Mutumbi, about 25 km from Bunia, delayed more than 24 hours in September after a family refused a burial sac. OMS data through 10 October indicate nearly 11,300 people have received psychosocial or mental health support in treatment and transit centers. Survivors and families often face social rejection, underscoring the need for integrated medical and mental health care to aid reintegration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱をめぐる恐怖とスティグマとの新たな闘い（ルポルタージュ）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,704例・4,687人死亡という大規模エボラ出血熱の流行が継続中であり、複数州に拡大し公衆衛生上深刻な影響を及ぼしているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の大規模エボラ流行（イツリ州中心、8州に拡大）における心理社会的支援とスティグマ対策に関するルポルタージュ。流行自体は継続中の既知イベントだが、累計9,704例・死亡4,687人という規模から継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: वाराणसी में HIV का बड़ा अलर्ट... 9 महीने में 300 से ज्यादा मिले पॉजिटिव मरीज, 18-25 के युवा सबसे ज्यादा शिकार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Major HIV Alert in Varanasi... Over 300 Positive Patients Detected in 9 Months; 18-25-Year-Olds Most Affected.
article.articleSummary: Varanasi reports a major HIV alert with 300+ new infections confirmed in Jan–Sept 2026, rising to over 700 when including adjacent districts Chandauli, Jaunpur, Azamgarh, Ghazipur and nearby Bihar. The 18–25-year-old cohort is most affected, driven by unsafe homosexual activity and shared syringes for injectable drugs. ICTC centers at DDU District Hospital tested ~20,000 people yielding 171 positives; BHU hospital ~150 positives. OST program data show about 30 infections linked to needle sharing in the past two years, with 2 women dying during treatment; roughly 35% of positives are injection-drug users. Four hotspots identified: Maldahiya, Shivdaspur, Cant, and Sadar Bazaar. Free HIV testing and counseling are available at six centers, including DDU Hospital, Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital, and BHU. 1097 National Helpline and the I-SCAN self-risk assessment app provide information and support.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァラナシでHIV感染急増の警告...9か月で300人以上が陽性、18〜25歳の若者が最も被害
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の風土病であり、地域の公衆衛生当局が検査・カウンセリング体制で対応している国内の疫学動向報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事はインド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州ヴァラナシ周辺地域における地域保健当局の検査データに基づく国内報道。国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Пятая страна в зоне риска из-за Эболы: где еще зафиксировали вирус
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fifth country in the at-risk zone due to Ebola: where else has the virus been detected.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 October 2026, Nigeria reports an imported Ebola case in Abuja: a woman who recently arrived from Uganda tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, marking the region's fifth country to report this strain. The patient is isolated and receiving treatment; 44 contacts are under close monitoring as investigators trace her movements to identify the source. Symptoms began on 7 October; she sought care on 11 October, and laboratory confirmation followed on 20 October. Nigeria’s National Center for Disease Control has declared an emergency and strengthened infection-control protocols at the treating hospital. The case arises amid a regional outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo since 15 May 2026; Kenya has nine similar diagnoses. WHO urges enhanced surveillance and border controls but avoids trade restrictions. The Bundibugyo strain lacks a licensed vaccine or specific antiviral; containment relies on rapid isolation and comprehensive contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の危険地域が5カ国目に拡大：ほかにどこでウイルスが確認されたか
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでウガンダ由来の輸入エボラ症例（ブンディブギョ株）が確認され、DRCを起源とする地域的流行が複数国に拡大していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の起源とされるDRCのみ対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）一关键性埃博拉疫苗临床试验启动接种
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A pivotal Ebola vaccine clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo begins vaccination.
article.articleSummary: On October 23, in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a participant in a pivotal clinical trial received the first vaccination with a Bundibugyo ebolavirus candidate vaccine. The trial, described by the Epidemic Prevention Innovation Alliance, marks a key step as this outbreak—began in May 2026 and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus—has no approved vaccine or targeted treatment to date. As of October 20, the DRC Health Ministry reports 9,704 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 4,687 deaths in this outbreak. The vaccine's first-dose administration occurs amid ongoing efforts to develop strain-specific interventions, though the report does not provide efficacy data. This milestone emphasizes the global prioritization of preparedness against diverse Ebola strains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で重要なエボラワクチン臨床試験の接種が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ(Bundibugyo株)アウトブレイクは9,704例・4,687死亡に達し、承認ワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心の高い事案である。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン臨床試験開始に関する報道だが、背景として2026年5月から続く大規模エボラ(Bundibugyo株)アウトブレイク（9,704例確定・4,687死亡）が既に進行中であり、既存の重大イベントとして継続的な監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Decade of Hangzhou data shows rotavirus shifts and myocardial injury signal
article.articleSummary: Hangzhou, China, reports a ten-year retrospective study at a single hospital (2016–2025) on pediatric rotavirus epidemiology and an exploratory link to myocardial injury. Among 71,115 rotavirus antigen test-episodes in children ≤15 years with acute diarrhoea, 11,553 were positive (16.25%), with peak positivity at age 1 (23.91%); one-year-olds accounted for 43.31% of positives. The annual pattern was volatile: 2017 peak 44.55%, 2023 nadir 2.80%, then 2024 9.02% and 2025 8.51%. Dividing by periods, pre-COVID positivity was 27.55%, mid-COVID 10.16%, post-COVID 6.82% (highly significant decline). Age shifts: median age rose from 1.0 to 2.0 to 3.0 years; ≥2 years among positives increased from 48.2% to 76.5%. Seasonality shifted from a winter-early-spring peak to a spring-centred pattern post-COVID. Myocardial injury was documented in 1.13% of rotavirus-positive episodes vs 0.42% of negatives (crude RR 2.67); associations stronger mid- and post-COVID. Limitations noted; authors urge increased cardiac awareness in hospitalized rotavirus-positive children.

triage.headline_ja: 杭州の10年間データがロタウイルスの変化と心筋傷害シグナルを示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は単一病院における過去10年間のロタウイルス疫学と心筋傷害の関連を調べた後ろ向き研究であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にCOVID-19と記載されているが、記事内容は実際にはロタウイルス感染症の疫学研究であり、COVID-19のアウトブレイク事例ではない。また過去10年間の後ろ向き研究報告であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため、対象国の発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Prayagraj News: एसआरएन के आवासीय परिसर में गंदगी से संक्रमण का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prayagraj News: Infection risk due to filth in SRN's residential campus.
article.articleSummary: Prayagraj SRN Hospital campus reports elevated infection risk from filth around workers' housing and a girls' hostel. Cleanliness gaps have allowed waste and stagnant water to accumulate near the nursing college, where a damaged sewer line fills the campus gate with contaminated water, affecting students, teachers, and staff. Over the past two months, 12 people have been hospitalized with dengue, underscoring the link between sanitation deficiencies and vector-borne disease on the hospital premises. The reported conditions—filthy surroundings around staff residences and ongoing sewage-related pooling—pose continuing health hazards for hospital workers and trainees at Prayagraj's SRN campus. No mention of broader outbreaks or laboratory confirmation beyond dengue hospitalizations is provided.

triage.headline_ja: プラヤグラジ・ニュース:SRN職員住宅地区の不衛生による感染リスク
triage.triage_reason: 単一病院施設内での衛生環境不良によるデング熱発生であり、地域的拡大や国際的懸念は認められず、局所的な衛生管理の問題にとどまる。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの風土病であり、本記事は特定病院施設の衛生管理問題を報じるローカルニュース。12人の入院は2ヶ月間の累積数であり、急激な増加や異常な動向は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: تجربة سريرية جديدة تعيد "الأمل" للكونغو الديمقراطية في مواجهة إيبولا | القاهرة الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new clinical trial restores 'hope' to the Democratic Republic of the Congo as it confronts Ebola | Cairo News
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo has launched a new clinical trial named Tumaini in Bunia, Ituri province, Oct 23, to evaluate potential vaccines against Ebola amid the current Bundibugyo outbreak, which as of Oct 21 had surpassed 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths since being declared on May 15. The adaptive Tumaini framework will assess several vaccines in parallel, starting with Ervebo (the vaccine approved for Zaire ebolavirus) to gauge potential protection against Bundibugyo. Later two candidate vaccines—one from Moderna using an mRNA platform, and another from Oxford University with the Serum Institute of India—will be added, forming a ring-vaccination strategy focusing on contacts and high-risk groups, including pregnant women and children. Alongside vaccination, surveillance, rapid diagnosis, isolation, contact tracing, infection prevention in health facilities, and community engagement remain essential to containment.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな臨床試験がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策に「希望」をもたらす | カイロ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（9,500例以上、死亡4,600例超）に関する新たなワクチン臨床試験の開始であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はブンディブギョ型エボラ流行への新ワクチン臨床試験（Tumaini）開始を報じるもので、既に大規模な死亡者数を伴う継続的なアウトブレイクが背景にある。国際的なワクチン開発（Moderna, Oxford/Serum Institute of India）が関与しており、国際支援の継続が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem de 7.106 para 12 em Balneário Camboriú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall from 7,106 to 12 in Balneário Camboriú.
article.articleSummary: Balneário Camboriú, Santa Catarina, Brazil, recorded 12 dengue cases from January–September 2026, down from 7,106 in 2024 (99.8% decline). No dengue deaths have occurred since 2025, following 13 deaths in 2023–2024. In 2024 Brazil experienced a record outbreak with over 6.5 million probable cases and more than 5,500 deaths. The city’s decline began in 2025 (724 cases) and continues in 2026. Reductions are linked to releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti, ongoing vector control, and vaccination. Releases ran August 2025 for six months in four neighborhoods: 26 weeks, two releases per week (52 actions), with Wolbitos from Joinville bio-factory. Wolbachia reduces transmission of dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and urban yellow fever and is heritable, with no genetic modification. Impact assessments are due 2–3 years after releases. Vaccination: 3,045 youths aged 10–16 received the first Qdenga dose; 1,357 completed two doses.

triage.headline_ja: バルネアリオ・カンボリウでデング熱症例が7,106件から12件に減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例の大幅な減少を報じる内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念拡大ではなく対策の成功事例であるため、シグナルとしてピックアップする必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱症例の劇的な減少とWolbachia感染蚊放出・ワクチン接種プログラムの成功を報告する内容であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Measles Outbreak: Five primary school kids test positive in Thottilpalam, Kozhikode
article.articleSummary: Five primary school children in the Kavilumpara panchayat of Thottilpalam, Kozhikode, Kerala, have tested positive for measles, marking an outbreak among Paikkalangadi students as of 25 October 2026. All affected children had missed the mandatory measles vaccination administered before age one. In response, the Kunduthode public health department has intensified prevention: health workers visiting homes, conducting ground surveys, and conducting vaccination awareness campaigns, along with ward sanitation committee meetings to curb transmission. The on-ground prevention drive is led by Health and Development Standing Committee Chairperson KP Nashma, Medical Officer Dr Neema Venugopal, and HS Prameela, with Junior Health Inspectors Joby Augustine, Muhammad Sabu, Rathusha, and Shins Sunny supporting the field efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州麻疹アウトブレイク:コジコードのトッティルパラムで小学生5人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 未接種児童5名の麻疹集団発生で地域限定の小規模事例だが、ワクチン未接種による拡大可能性があり経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nearly 900 HIV Cases Detected In Varanasi In 10 Months, Over Half Among Adolescents & Young Adults
article.articleSummary: HIV infections in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, reached about 903 confirmed cases between January and October 2026, with 728 positives at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Hospital and 175 at Deen Dayal Upadhyay District Hospital. The data show a concentration among urban residents and among adolescents and young adults aged 15–45. Transmission routes cited include sharing syringes for drug use, unprotected sex, and tattooing with unsterilized needles. At the district hospital’s OST center, 30 people who shared syringes tested HIV-positive over the past two years, including two women who died; injectors accounted for roughly 35% of cases seen at the center. Of BHU-linked positives from January–September, about 150 were from Varanasi itself, with the remainder from districts in eastern Uttar Pradesh (Jaunpur, Ghazipur, Mau, Chandauli, Sonbhadra, Bhadohi), Bihar, and beyond. Free testing and ART are available; ongoing counseling and preventive education target adolescents and young adults.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァラナシで10ヶ月間に約900件のHIV感染確認、半数以上が青少年・若年成人
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の風土病的感染症であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれにも該当せず、国際的拡大リスクや緊急性も認められない通常の公衆衛生報告である。
triage.notes: 既知の性感染症・血液媒介感染症であるHIVの地域的な症例報告であり、新興感染症や突発的アウトブレイクには該当しない。既存の医療・検査体制で対応可能な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Review Maps the Forces That Shape Infection Control in Operating Rooms
article.articleSummary: Four themes shape adherence to infection prevention in operating rooms: organizational support, professional/team dynamics, knowledge and training, and PPE challenges. A mixed-methods review of 13 studies (2012–2025; updated Aug 2026) finds adherence arises from these interactions, not sole individual willingness. Healthcare-associated infections affect about 7% of hospitalized patients in high-income countries and 15% in LMICs; Australia reports around 170,000 infections and over 7,500 deaths annually. MRSA contamination on anesthesia hands can transmit between cases within a session. Studies across the UK, US, Tunisia, Türkiye, Iran, India, Singapore, Switzerland and China link organizational conditions, signage/traffic cues, and PPE storage to adherence. In the US, structured education and feedback raised cleaning thoroughness from 47% to 82% and anesthesia equipment cleaning from 25% to 77%; a multicomponent intraoperative program reduced S. aureus transmission from 24% to 9% and surgical-site infections from 8% to 3% with six-month follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: レビュー論文:手術室における感染対策を形作る要因をマッピング
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、手術室の感染対策に関する文献レビュー記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は医療関連感染対策に関する学術レビューであり、特定の対象国での疾病発生イベントではない。verified_locationsは対象国リストに含まれる国（中国、インド）を言及のみ記載したが、これらは研究対象地域の一部に過ぎず、発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 日遊客發燒入境就醫確診登革熱 高市衛生局全面清消旅館周邊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Feverish Japanese tourist on arrival diagnosed with dengue fever; Kaohsiung City Health Bureau conducts thorough disinfection around the hotel.
article.articleSummary: Three dengue fever cases were reported in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, with active containment measures as of 2026-10-25. A feverish Japanese traveler, who entered from Thailand, exhibited dengue-like symptoms during the first three days and was diagnosed; authorities conducted source investigations and chemical disinfection around the youth hostel where the person stayed. A second case, a 48-year-old woman in Sanmin District, had fever and rash before returning from Vietnam; she self-medicated, returned afebrile, but was confirmed ill after arriving at hospital on Oct 22. A third case, a 38-year-old man in Renwu District, traveled to the Philippines from Oct 8–18 and was diagnosed the day after returning. The Kaohsiung Health Bureau emphasized emergency control measures around affected communities and intensified surveillance to prevent further spread of dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 日本人観光客が発熱で入国後受診、デング熱と確診――高雄市衛生局がホテル周辺を全面消毒
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄での輸入デング熱症例3件の報告であり、通常の検疫・防疫対応の範囲内。対象国での発生ではなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
