article.articleSummary: As of 25 October 2026, Ebola virus disease in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has 19 confirmed cases and 9 deaths, with 5 recoveries, 2 patients still hospitalized, and 3 having left the Ebola Treatment Center in Bafwasende before completing care. In a separate incident, two nurses from the Kenge health area were attacked Sunday in the Ligili neighborhood of Bafwasende by a furious crowd accusing them of contaminating a river to spread Ebola; one nurse died and the other was seriously injured. The authorities demand an immediate investigation to identify and prosecute the perpetrators. The violence highlights safety risks for frontline health workers and the ongoing challenge of misinformation, which can undermine outbreak response and hasten transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: バフワセンデでのエボラ：看護師1名が殺害され、もう1名が重傷を負わされる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の確認症例19件・死者9名が発生しており、さらに誤情報による医療従事者襲撃という二次被害も生じているため、公衆衛生上重大かつ対応管理に懸念があるシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: エボラ致死率の高さに加え、治療センターからの無断離脱者3名や誤情報による医療従事者への暴力事件が確認されており、アウトブレイク対応の障害となるリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : 76 cas confirmés d'Ebola, dont 33 décès au 22 octobre - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: 76 confirmed Ebola cases, including 33 deaths as of October 22 - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Tshopo province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with 76 laboratory-confirmed cases and 33 deaths reported as of 22 October 2026. Of the confirmed cases, 43 are living; 35 have been declared recovered, and the case-fatality rate is 43.4%. Data cover seven of the province’s 23 health zones. Health authorities continue epidemiological surveillance to monitor the outbreak’s evolution and guide response efforts. Kisangani serves as the reporting point for this update, reflecting ongoing monitoring within the province. The information is summarized from the provincial health division’s surveillance report and released on 25 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:エボラ確定症例76件、10月22日時点で死亡33人 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の確定症例76例・致死率43.4%という重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラは致死率が高く国際的に重大視される疾患であり、州内7/23保健圏に拡大していることから継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda clears all 60 contacts of Kenyan Ebola case - The Observer Media Ltd
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms 60 contacts linked to a Kenyan Ebola case completed 21-day follow-up and were discharged; none tested positive or developed symptoms. Uganda has not recorded a new Ebola case since declaring the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak ended on July 28, 2026, with outbreak confirmed May 15. Despite cross-border transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda maintains vigilance. Investigations continue into a reported Ebola case in Nigeria involving a woman who travelled from Uganda to Abuja; authorities are examining travel history, movements, interactions, and genomic sequencing to determine relation to known strains, with results to be released after completion. Contacts included entry/exit personnel, hotel staff, and transport operators across monitoring sites; intensified screening at Entebbe Airport, land borders, and road checkpoints. No confirmed cases in Kasese or nearby districts; public urged to report symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、ケニア人エボラ症例の接触者60人全員を解除
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国への越境伝播やナイジェリアでの症例調査など複数国にまたがるエボラ関連事案であり、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスクに該当するためフルRRAでの精査が必要。
triage.notes: 主な舞台はウガンダ（対象国リスト外）だが、DRCへの越境伝播に言及あり。ナイジェリアでの症例調査結果は未確定。続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 流感高发季来临 医生支招青少年儿童科学防护
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The peak flu season is here; doctors offer tips for adolescents and children on protective measures.
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains a major respiratory threat as autumn–winter season arrives in Changsha, Hunan. Pediatric wards report rising number of children with flu; adolescents and children should strengthen preventive measures. Hunan Provincial People’s Hospital Children’s Medical Center chief physician Zeng Saizhen emphasizes vaccination as key. The trivalent inactivated influenza vaccine is suitable for the general population; high-risk groups including elderly, adolescents and children, and frontline healthcare workers should be prioritized for early inoculation to reduce infection, severe illness, and complications. For ages 3–17, in addition to the conventional inactivated vaccine, nasal spray live attenuated influenza vaccine is an option, offering easier administration. Influenza spreads mainly via respiratory droplets and can spread via contaminated objects, with potential school and public-venue clusters. Recommendations: proper mask-wearing in crowded indoor spaces, frequent hand hygiene, and timely vaccination, along with hygiene, regular routines, and physical activity to boost immunity.

triage.headline_ja: 流感高発シーズン到来 医師が青少年・児童の科学的予防策をアドバイス
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行期に関する一般的な医療広報記事であり、特定の異常な集団発生やアウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Issues Update on Ebola Contacts Linked to Kenya's First Imported Case
article.articleSummary: As of 25 October 2026, Uganda's Ministry of Health announced all 60 contacts traced in connection with Kenya's first Ebola case have completed a 21‑day monitoring period and were discharged after showing no symptoms. Health Minister Dr Chris Baryomunsi said the Kenyan traveler moved through Uganda before the infection was reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The contact-tracing covered entry/exit personnel, hotel staff, and transport operators who interacted with the traveler, with daily symptom checks throughout the 21 days. Uganda reiterates it remains Ebola-free with no active cases. The update underscores regional cross-border efforts to prevent transmission, with authorities coordinating with Kenya and the DRC. The minister warned of consequences for unverified cross-border entries by DRC nationals, highlighting ongoing vigilance against Ebola spread in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、ケニアの輸入エボラ症例に関連した接触者への対応状況を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラウイルスがケニアへ越境輸入され、ウガンダ経由で接触者追跡が行われた事例であり、国際的な感染拡大リスクと渡航制限の懸念があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダとケニアでの対応だが、感染源はDRCでのエボラ発生であるため、対象国リストに該当するDRCのみを発生地域として記録。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sesenta contactos en Uganda de un caso de ébola de Kenia completan 21 días de cuarentena
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sixty contacts in Uganda of a Kenyan Ebola case have completed 21 days of quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease: As of 25 October 2026, 60 Ugandan contacts of the first Kenyan Ebola case (a traveler who passed through Uganda en route from DR Congo) have completed 21 days of monitoring without symptoms; none tested positive. Ugandan Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi said all were quarantined and will be barred from flying until monitoring ends. Kenya has recorded nine Ebola infections, with the index patient and a close relative dead and seven others still receiving care. DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak affects eight provinces with 9,876 confirmed cases and 4,803 deaths (data through 23 October). Cases linked to the outbreak have also appeared in Nigeria, the Netherlands, and France. Uganda’s own outbreak ended on 26 August, after 20 confirmed infections (15 imported from DR Congo) and two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダにおけるケニアのエボラ症例の接触者60人が21日間の隔離を完了
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（9,876例確定、4,803死亡）が複数国（ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、オランダ、フランス）に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生した第17次エボラアウトブレイクの国際的波及（ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、オランダ、フランスへの拡大）。これら波及先の国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外し、発生源であるDRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandeses que vuelvan tras viajar a RDC deberán hacer 21 días de cuarentena por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ugandans returning after traveling to the DRC must quarantine for 21 days due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda requires a 21-day quarantine for Ugandan nationals returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo with a travel history there, the Ministry of Health announced, covering the Ebola incubation period. Border movement is restricted to essential travelers, including humanitarian workers and commercial truck drivers. The measure follows Ebola-linked cases across several countries tied to the DRC outbreak, including Nigeria, which confirmed an imported case traced to a Swiss-Ugandan citizen who vacationed in Uganda. Kenya has nine Ebola cases connected to the outbreak (first imported case on Oct 5 via Uganda); two deaths have occurred, seven patients remain under care. The DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, across eight provinces, has 9,876 confirmed cases and 4,803 deaths (as of Oct 23). Uganda had been declared to have ended the outbreak on Aug 26. Cases were also reported in the Netherlands and France (one each).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国への渡航後に帰国するウガンダ人、エボラ出血熱のため21日間の検疫が義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行（9,876症例・4,803死亡）が複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、オランダ、フランス）に拡大しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大な国際的公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはオランダ、フランス、ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアも含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。震源地であるDRCのみを記載。既に国際的な越境伝播が複数国で確認されており、WHO国際保健規則上も重大な懸念事案。

article.articleHeadline: Nhận diện sớm để chủ động phòng bệnh não mô cầu đến phát triển kinh tế
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early detection to proactively prevent meningococcal disease and promote economic development.
article.articleSummary: Five cases of Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B meningococcal disease were reported in Ho Chi Minh City from 14–21 October 2026, including one fatality (a 14-year-old) at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước. A 12-year-old student in Thường Tân, who attends Ngo Thời Nhiệm School in Bình Dương, tested positive; serogroup B was confirmed by Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City. The Hai Bà Trưng cluster comprises four school cases; by 19 October three remained in stable condition. The Thường Tân case had recovered by 21 October. Disease can progress rapidly, with septic shock developing within 6–24 hours; early signs include fever, severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, or altered consciousness. Public health actions: prophylaxis for close contacts—177 at Hiệp Phước (total 2,031 people) and 99 at Thường Tân—with monitoring through 25 October. Vaccination options include serogroup B, or combinations B-C, or A/C/Y/W; one vaccinated child had A/C/Y/W but not B.

triage.headline_ja: 経済発展のための早期発見・能動的な髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎予防
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市とビンズオン省の学校で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスター（5例、死亡1例）が発生し、濃厚接触者2000人超への予防投与が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 学校2校で発生したクラスターで、血清群Bが確認され、急速に進行し敗血症性ショックに至る可能性が指摘されている。濃厚接触者への予防投与とワクチン接種状況の確認が進行中。国際的拡大の情報はなく、現時点ではベトナム国内の局地的事例。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penularan Mematikan, Ratusan WBP di Maluku Mendadak Jalani Skrining HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent Deadly Transmission, Hundreds of Inmates in Maluku Suddenly Undergo HIV Screening.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 October 2026, the Maluku regional office of the Directorate General of Prisons expanded HIV and sexually transmitted infections (STIs) screening across detention facilities. At Ambon Class III Female Penitentiary, in partnership with Passo Health Center, 85 female inmates underwent HIV and STI screening to enable early detection and raise health awareness. Similar efforts were conducted at Ambon Class IIA Penitentiary with the Mobile HIV and STI Team from Passo. At Tual Class IIB Penitentiary, screening included HIV Voluntary Counseling and Testing (VCT), tuberculosis (TB) screening, and STI symptom checks. The program emphasizes confidentiality of results and timely referral for needed care, and coordination with local health facilities to sustain services, reinforcing disease prevention and inmates’ right to healthcare.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な感染を予防するため、マルクの数百人の受刑者が突然HIVスクリーニングを受ける
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での通常の公衆衛生プログラム（HIV・STI・結核スクリーニング）であり、異常なアウトブレイクや新規感染拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: これは既存の公衆衛生対策（スクリーニングプログラム）の報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではないため対象国リストへの計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Karantina 21 Hari Warga yang Memiliki Riwayat Perjalanan ke Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Imposes a 21-Day Quarantine on Residents with Travel History to Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine for residents returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to curb Ebola virus disease (EVD) transmission, effective 25 October 2026, as the government reiterates Uganda remains Ebola-free. The measure accompanies heightened surveillance amid an Ebola investigation in Nigeria linked to a woman who previously traveled from Uganda; authorities are tracing potential epidemiological connections through genomic sequencing, travel histories, interactions, and movements across borders. Separately, 60 contacts of an Ebola case in Kenya have completed a 21-day monitoring period. Uganda has intensified screening at Entebbe International Airport and land borders, requiring all travelers to fill a passenger-tracking form. Genomic analysis of the Nigerian case shows the virus closely relates to the strain found in Kenya’s index case, with Nigeria reporting no evidence of travel or direct link from Kenya’s index case. Uganda remains vigilant due to its proximity to the DRC and past outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴへの渡航歴がある住民に21日間の検疫措置を課す
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生を受け、ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアにまたがる国際的な感染拡大・渡航制限の動きがあり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ発生を受けたウガンダの検疫措置及びナイジェリア・ケニアでの関連症例調査。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCはエボラ発生源として主題に含まれるため記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Ceticismo e violência dificultam combate na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Skepticism and violence hinder the fight against Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows high transmission amid local skepticism and violence, with the outbreak progressing 'in the shadows' of official statistics. As of October 20, the WHO Africa region reports 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), though field views say numbers are higher. MSF warns many cases remain unreachable due to security constraints and community distrust; Nyankunde suffered attacks in July, but 1,500+ leaders engaged across 32 dialogues raised daily alerts from 11 to 60–70 by September, with no new attacks since July. In Mongbwalu, trust has improved and treatment centers are used again. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, spreading in a conflict zone with mass displacement and concurrent cholera and malaria. Immediate needs: safe humanitarian access, predictable funding, reliable frontline pay, and adequate supplies; efforts should not detract from malaria and other vaccination campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：懐疑心と暴力がコンゴ民主共和国での対応を困難にしている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは症例9,704件、死亡4,687件（致死率48.3%）と極めて深刻で、紛争地域での治安悪化・コミュニティの不信・コレラとマラリアの同時流行が複合し、人道支援と国際的な資金・物資支援が急務であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、紛争地帯における治安上の制約と住民の不信感により実際の症例数は公式統計より多い可能性が指摘されている。コレラ・マラリアとの同時流行、大規模な住民避難も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Pune: PMC Inspects 14 Lakh Houses, Detects Mosquito Breeding In 13,000, Collects ₹6.3 Lakh In Fines
article.articleSummary: Pune, Maharashtra reports ongoing dengue transmission with PMC measures. Since January, the PMC inspected 1.4 million homes, finding Aedes breeding in ~13,000 houses and larvae in 18,885 containers; 2,664 notices were issued and ₹6.30 lakh in fines collected. A total of 2.83 million containers and water-storage sites were surveyed; measures include fogging, indoor spraying, removal of breeding sites, and daily monitoring. Dr Nina Borade says Pune normally records 4,000–5,000 dengue cases annually; this year starting January, 2,413 were recorded but revised to 2,291 after removing 122 duplicates. The PMC surveys ~100 houses within 300 metres of a dengue patient. Isolation beds: 50 at Dr Naidu Hospital (3 occupied, 35 vacant). Private hospitals have ~23,000 beds; free confirmatory testing at Dr Naidu, Dr Kotnis, Kamala Nehru; rapid dengue tests at dispensaries. Dengue-carrying Aedes breed in clean water around homes, pots, tyres, coconut shells.

triage.headline_ja: プネー：PMCが140万戸を検査、13,000戸で蚊の発生を確認、63万ルピーの罰金を徴収
triage.triage_reason: プネーのデング熱は例年通りの季節的流行で、今年の症例数はむしろ平年を下回っており、行政による通常の対策（防疫・罰金徴収）が機能している。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はプネーで毎年流行する風土病であり、今年の症例数(2,291件)は例年(4,000〜5,000件)を下回っている。地方自治体(PMC)による通常の防除活動が報告されているのみで、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Mudanças climáticas aceleram avanço de doenças infecciosas no país -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change accelerates the spread of infectious diseases in the country -- Política Distrital is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Climate change and extreme weather are accelerating infectious disease spread across Brazil. Fiocruz data and Rio de Janeiro specialists link rising temperatures and hydrological extremes to pathogen expansion. Dengue has spread from 110 to 292 microregions (2006–2024), now covering about 54% of the country. Rio Grande do Sul recorded nearly 210,000 infections and 281 deaths in 2024, surpassing Bahia’s 163,000. Oropouche fever has moved from the Amazon to 23 states and the Federal District, with over 12,000 notifications. Floods increased leptospirosis and water contamination, contributing to hepatitis A and GI illness. Droughts and fires drive wild rodent displacement, elevating hantavirus infections (530 cases, 212 deaths since 2016; ~40% fatality). Fungal threats rise: Candida auris caused 24 hospital outbreaks in 15 states since 2020 (146 patients, 56 deaths; 82% lethality in bloodstream). Trichophyton indotineae (2022) shows resistance; humidity shifts expand Aspergillus.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がブラジル国内での感染症拡大を加速 -- Política DistritalはPDNewsに名称変更、連邦直轄区の政治・保健ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動とブラジル国内の複数感染症（デング熱、オロプーシェ熱、ハンタウイルス、レプトスピラ症、薬剤耐性真菌等）の拡大傾向をまとめた総説的記事であり、単一の新規アウトブレイクという性質は薄いが、オロプーシェ熱の地理的拡大やハンタウイルスの高致死率など注視すべき情報を含むため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル国内の気候変動と複数感染症（デング熱、オロプーシェ熱、ハンタウイルス、レプトスピラ症、Candida auris等薬剤耐性真菌）の長期的拡大傾向をまとめた分析記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。個別疾患の最新動向（特にオロプーシェ熱の23州拡大、ハンタウイルス致死率40%）は継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde mental é prioridade na resposta à epidemia de Ébola na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mental health is a priority in the response to the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts MSF to prioritize mental health in its response, with field work centered in Mongbwalu. Tomás Bandeira, MSF Tropical Medicine lead, states psychological support is provided to healthcare staff, patients, and families from admission through post-discharge, building family and community networks to cope with the disease's impact. The roughly 50% case fatality burden places intense stress on clinicians. WHO Africa Regional Director Mohamed Yakub Janabi notes that by 20 October the DRC had 9,704 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths, a 48.3% fatality rate. Ebola is highly contagious via direct contact with infected fluids (blood, vomit) or contaminated materials such as bedding. The article underlines mental health integration as a cornerstone of ongoing outbreak management.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ流行対応でメンタルヘルス支援が優先事項に
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラの大規模流行が継続しており、致死率約48%と深刻で、国際的拡大リスクやIHR複数基準に該当するためフルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOアフリカ地域事務局長の発言として9,704例の確定症例、4,687人の死亡（致死率48.3%）が報告されており、既に大規模なアウトブレイクが進行中。MSFによるメンタルヘルス支援活動が記事の主眼だが、背景の疫学情報から継続的なリスク評価が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Cúm, sốt xuất huyết, não mô cầu cùng tấn công: Đâu mới là "kẻ thù" nguy hiểm nhất?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza, dengue fever, and meningococcal meningitis strike together: Which is the most dangerous 'enemy'?
article.articleSummary: Influenza, dengue fever, and meningococcal meningitis are evaluated in Ho Chi Minh City as of 25 October 2026. Dengue is the least dangerous, influenza is intermediate, and meningococcal meningitis is the most lethal risk due to potential fatal outcomes. Dengue is in peak season; influenza season continues, with H1N1 2009 as the dominant strain and imperfect population immunity. Preventive measures and vaccination are emphasized. Self-testing for meningococcus with throat swabs is not practical; influenza rapid tests require physician guidance to avoid misinterpretation. Meningococcal bacteria colonize the throat of about 10–20% of healthy people, more in smokers; carriage does not equal disease. Invasive meningococcal infection needs blood/CSF confirmation, and close contacts should receive prophylaxis; vaccines reduce carriage but do not eradicate it. Influenza spreads readily, while meningococcus tends to cause sporadic cases or small clusters.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ、デング熱、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が同時流行：最も危険な「敵」はどれか？
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、ホーチミン市における季節性疾患（インフルエンザ・デング熱・髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎）に関する一般的な健康啓発・予防情報記事であり、異常な増加や新規事例の報告はない。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数や異常な流行状況の記載はなく、季節性疾患に関する教育的・予防啓発コンテンツと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Lucknow News: डेंगू का डंक तेज 24 और मरीज मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucknow News: Dengue cases intensify; 24 more patients found.
article.articleSummary: 24 more dengue cases confirmed in Lucknow, India, on Sunday, signaling a worsening outbreak. The health department reports infections across multiple residential areas, notably Aliganj, Indiranagar, and Alambagh, amid widespread waterlogging that boosts Aedes mosquito proliferation. Preventive guidance emphasizes avoiding standing water and ensuring containers, coolers, flower pots, rooftops, and water tanks are covered or emptied regularly, since even clean water can foster larvae. Officials expect mosquito activity to decline as temperatures fall, with a possible reduction in dengue cases over the next two weeks. Symptoms prompting medical advice include fever, headache, body pains, and retro-orbital pain; red-flag signs—severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, or extreme weakness—require urgent hospital care. No imported/exported case details are provided; cases are locally confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: Lucknowニュース：デング熱の感染拡大、新たに24人の患者が確認される
triage.triage_reason: インドのLucknowにおける季節性のデング熱の局地的な増加であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの季節性流行病であり、地域の保健当局が通常の予防策（水たまり除去等）で対応している。気温低下により今後2週間で症例減少が見込まれるとの報道あり、重篤な公衆衛生上の懸念は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : neuf personnes guéries en une semaine au CTE de Katwa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: Nine people cured in one week at the Katwa Ebola Treatment Centre.
article.articleSummary: Nine people were cured of Ebola at Katwa Ebola Treatment Centre in Butembo, North Kivu, during the Oct 19–23, 2026 week. Discharges: Oct 23—three cured (22-year-old? correction: a 24-year-old woman cured; two non-cases: 50-year-old woman, 36-year-old man). Oct 21—four discharges (three cured: a 27-year-old healthcare worker infected on duty, a 19-year-old girl, a 9-year-old girl; one non-case: a 55-year-old woman). Oct 19—two cured: an 11-year-old boy and a 23-year-old man. Katwa CTE is operated by Medair with Ministry of Public Health partners. Dr. Jean Mukoko Kambale urged sustained PPE supply and partner support to avoid hampering response. As of Oct 22, 2026, North Kivu had 2,291 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,325 deaths ( CFR ~58% ); Katwa 685/442, Beni 576/403, Butembo 351/196. Province totals: 265 recovered, 658 active; 28 new confirmed and 188 suspected cases; 19,511 contacts, 15,974 followed that day.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボのエボラ出血熱：カトワ治療センターで1週間に9人が回復
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（致死率約58%、活動症例658件）に関する継続報告であり、深刻な公衆衛生インパクトと国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクを有するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の継続中エボラアウトブレイク（北キブ州・ブテンボ/カトワ）の最新回復状況報告。致死率約58%、活動症例658件、新規確認28件・疑い188件と依然深刻な状況が続いており、PPE供給等の外部支援の必要性も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس شاموندا ينتقل من المواشي إلى الإنسان لأول مرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shamonda virus jumps from livestock to humans for the first time.
article.articleSummary: France reports the first known human infection with Shamonda virus in a man in his 60s with leukemia, in the Rhône-Alpes region. He died on October 9, 16 days after neurological onset (seizures, vision loss, confusion) and required ventilation. A European cattle outbreak linked to the virus was first detected in July, with investigators suspecting transmission via bites from horseflies or biting midges. Routine blood tests do not detect Shamonda virus; full sequencing found the virus in cerebrospinal fluid, with a genome nearly identical to animal isolates but five mutations not seen in animals, whose significance is unknown. There is no evidence of human-to-human transmission; theoretical risks include contaminated food, blood products, or organ transplantation, though investigations aim to rule these out. French authorities may intensify monitoring of biting insects. The report notes rising bunyavirus detections in humans, influenced by climate and wildlife–livestock–human contact, and cites vertical transmission of Oropouche virus in Brazil in 2024.

triage.headline_ja: シャモンダウイルスが初めて家畜からヒトへ感染
triage.triage_reason: 家畜由来のシャモンダウイルスによる世界初のヒト感染例であり、患者は死亡しているため公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性の2基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 本事例の主な発生地はフランス（対象国リスト外）であり、ブラジルは2024年のオロプーシュウイルス垂直感染の参考事例として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda, que insiste en que está "libre de ébola", refuerza controles en sus fronteras e impondrá algunas cuarentenas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda, which insists it is Ebola-free, strengthens border controls and will impose some quarantines.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to threaten Africa, with the outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), which has surpassed 9,700 cases and 4,687 deaths. Kenya reports a second Ebola death and Nigeria an infection in over a decade, intensifying regional concern. Uganda, the fourth WHO alert, saw two deaths and about twenty cases linked to DRC last summer but now declares itself Ebola-free after 42 days without new cases; the first Kenyan case reportedly passed through Uganda. As of October 25, 2026, Uganda reinforces controls: no exemptions from port health screening; questionnaires for all entrants; a 21-day quarantine for returnees who transited via Congo; regional border restrictions to essential travel; three treatment units were established in Congo with 240 beds. The Ugandan health ministry is reviewing genomic data and tracing contacts; Nigeria’s case is under investigation for possible export/import links, with findings to be disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラフリー」を主張するウガンダ、国境管理を強化し一部で検疫措置を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRC中心のエボラアウトブレイクがケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境伝播し、死亡者数も多数（4,687人）に上るため、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として即座にフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC発のエボラアウトブレイクを中心に、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境伝播と各国の対応を報じているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダはverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: DoH rolls out flu vaccines as seasonal cases rise
article.articleSummary: DoH reports an 8% rise in influenza-like illnesses, with 11,137 cases logged in the latest monitoring period, up from 10,378 between 3-16 September. Cumulative year-to-date ILI totals reach 122,514, though overall ILI activity remains about 20% lower than 152,972 cases for the same period in 2025. Seasonal surges tied to indoor gatherings, with holidays through Christmas and New Year cited as potential accelerants. To counter the uptick, DoH Acting Secretary Edwin Mercado announced a nationwide influenza vaccination rollout starting next week, running through December, prioritizing senior citizens, toddlers, and people with underlying conditions. Flu-like illnesses are largely caused by common respiratory viruses; Mercado reassured that the influenza infection rate is manageable and not fatal, advising rest, hydration, and nutrition. Weekly Covid-19 infections rose to 291 from 245, but officials say this does not signify an outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザ症例の増加を受け、保健省がワクチン接種を展開
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の増加であり、当局も管理可能で致死性はないと説明しており、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 前年同期比で約20%低い水準であり、通常の季節性流行パターン。COVID-19週次感染者数も291例と少数で、当局はアウトブレイクではないと明言している。

locations.name: Virgin Islands of the United States

article.articleHeadline: Every traveler to the U.S. risks getting grounded over ebola
article.articleSummary: Beginning Nov. 3 at 11:59 p.m. EST, every passenger on an international flight to the United States must sign a statement that they were not in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the prior 21 days. Issued Oct. 22 during the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, the CDC order applies to all travelers, with land or sea arrivals exempt and flights from Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U.S. Virgin Islands not considered international. Airlines must verify completion and keep the forms for 42 days after landing. The attestation is not medical testing; lying is a federal crime. The rule runs through Dec. 18, with possible extensions. Congo accounts for the vast majority of the outbreak, which by Oct. 21 totaled 9,735 cases and 4,690 deaths worldwide (Congo 9,704/4,687). Active transmission spans 66 health zones across eight provinces, with cases also in Uganda, Kenya, France and Nigeria; the Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak, prompting a WHO PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国への全渡航者、エボラ出血熱を巡り渡航制限のリスクに直面
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で、死者数が多く複数国に拡大し、米国が渡航制限措置を導入するなどIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 米国、フランス、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア等も発生地域として挙げられているが、記事の主題である流行の中心はコンゴ民主共和国であり、対象国リストにある国としてはDRCのみを採用した。米国はCDCによる渡航対策の実施国であり発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mudanças climáticas impulsionam avanço de dengue, febre do Oropouche e fungos superresistentes no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change drives the spread of dengue, Oropouche fever, and super-resistant fungi in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Climate-driven thermal anomalies and rainfall shifts are reshaping Brazil's infectious-disease map, according to Fiocruz. Dengue transmission now spans 292 microregions (54% of the country), up from 110 in 2006. The Aedes aegypti mosquito has breached cooler regions, including Rio Grande do Sul, which reported about 210,000 dengue infections and 281 deaths in 2024. Oropouche fever—once confined to the Amazon—has expanded to 23 states and the Federal District, with more than 12,000 cases recorded. Extreme events such as wildfires and droughts are driving rodent migration and increasing hantavirus exposure, with a national case fatality around 40%. Emerging fungal threats include Candida auris, which has colonized 146 patients and caused 56 deaths in Brazil since 2020; 82% mortality when bloodstream infections occur. The findings underscore climate-change-linked shifts in vector, zoonotic, and hospital-acquired infections.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がブラジルにおけるデング熱、オロプーシュ熱、スーパー耐性真菌の拡大を後押し
triage.triage_reason: オロプーシュ熱がアマゾン地域から23州・連邦区へ拡大し1万2千例超、ハンタウイルス致死率約40%など、複数の感染症が気候変動により地理的・疫学的に拡大している実態が公的研究機関(Fiocruz)により報告されており、重症度・流行継続性の観点からフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はFiocruzによる複数感染症(デング熱、オロプーシュ熱、ハンタウイルス、カンジダ・アウリス)の気候変動関連拡大トレンドに関する総説的報道であり、単発の急性アウトブレイク速報ではない。特にオロプーシュ熱の地理的拡大(アマゾン限定から23州へ)は新興感染症として注視価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: PMC Appoints 17 Officers to Step up Mosquito Control, Asks Residents to Report Breeding Sites
article.articleSummary: Pune, India: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) has appointed 17 ward officers to tighten mosquito control to curb dengue, chikungunya and malaria, and asks residents to report breeding sites. Health authorities urge removing stagnant water and warn Aedes mosquitoes breed in clean, standing water. When larvae are found in stored water, pour it onto the ground; contact ward offices or the Pest Control Department for large sites and pesticide spraying. Households should keep containers covered, scrub interiors when refilling, prevent collection of water in tyres, plastic containers, coconut shells, flowerpot trays, refrigerators, air coolers, vases, or money plant containers; fit mesh on toilet vents; wear full-sleeve clothing and use nets during the day. Encourage guppy fish in suitable water bodies. Housing societies must secure tank covers and keep terraces free of waste. Free dengue and malaria tests available at PMC clinics; seek early medical evaluation for fever or rash.

triage.headline_ja: プネー市当局、蚊対策強化のため17名の担当官を任命、住民に発生源の報告を要請
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生対策（蚊媒介感染症の予防啓発・行政対応）に関する記事であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増等の報告はない。
triage.notes: 市当局による季節性の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）予防のルーティン対応であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵剛果伊波拉疫情擴散　烏干達宣布返國者隔離21天 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To curb the spread of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda announces a 21-day quarantine for returnees.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its most severe Ebola outbreak to date, with more than 4,600 deaths since May, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. There is no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral treatment available. To curb cross-border spread, Uganda’s Ministry of Health ordered all returnees from the DRC to undergo a 21-day, self-funded quarantine and tightened traveler screening at Entebbe International Airport and across land borders, with checkpoints on designated routes. WHO had in August declared Uganda a non-Ebola-affected area, and Ugandan authorities note around 20 cases (including 2 deaths) in the country, nearly all linked to travel to the DRC. Kenya has reported 2 Ebola deaths and Nigeria has confirmed a first case—a woman who flew from Uganda to Abuja—though Uganda maintains there are no active Ebola cases within its borders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ(DRC)でのエボラ流行拡大を防ぐため、ウガンダが帰国者に21日間の隔離を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,600人以上の死者を出す過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）を主題とし、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・特効治療薬が存在しない点も深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda uvodi obavezni karantin od 21 dan za sve građane koji se vrate iz Konga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda imposes a 21-day mandatory quarantine for all citizens returning from Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 October 2026, Uganda imposes a 21-day mandatory quarantine for all citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo amid ongoing Ebola controls, with Uganda stating no current infections and noting the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak ended on 28 July 2026. Border and airport surveillance have been intensified; entrants by air, land, or water must complete travel and location forms. A total of 60 contacts exposed to a confirmed Kenyan case completed 21 days of monitoring without symptoms and were released. Uganda is also investigating an Ebola case in Nigeria—a woman who arrived from Uganda—and, with Nigerian authorities and partners, is analyzing the viral genome, movement of the infected individual, and contacts. In Kenya, a second death was confirmed, a 65-year-old woman who died while in quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者全員に21日間の強制検疫を導入
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアにまたがり拡大しており、ケニアでの死亡例確認やナイジェリアでの輸入症例調査、ウガンダの渡航制限措置など、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす国際的な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダの検疫措置はコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者を対象としており、DRCでのエボラ感染状況が背景にあると考えられる。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ケニアでの死亡確認やナイジェリアでの症例調査など多国間での感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: [굿모닝베트남미디어] [사회/보건] 자라이성 뎅기열 환자 9,000명 넘어, 사망자 1명 발생
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Good Morning Vietnam Media] [Society/Health] Zairean dengue fever cases exceed 9,000, with one death.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Gia Lai Province, Vietnam has surpassed 9,000 cases with one death as of October 25, 2026. The provincial health department reports 9,000+ infections this year, about 6,000 more than the same period last year, and 450+ year-to-date with a weekly rise of 17 new cases. The most affected districts are Pleiku (107), Krong Pa (92), Chu Prong (73), Chu Se (53), Dak Doa (43), and Hoai An (33). Ongoing monsoon and humid weather are driving mosquito proliferation and transmission. Public health actions include insecticide spraying, larval source reduction, and environmental sanitation; residents are urged to remove unnecessary water containers, cover water-holding items, and maintain cleanliness. Suspected dengue symptoms should prompt immediate medical testing and treatment; self-treatment is discouraged. Authorities anticipate continued prevention efforts, surveillance, and community outreach to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: [グッドモーニングベトナムメディア] [社会/保健] ジアライ省のデング熱患者が9,000人を超え、死者1人発生
triage.triage_reason: ジアライ省で例年より大幅に多いデング熱症例（前年同期比約6,000人増）が報告されているが、死亡者は1人にとどまり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの季節性流行であり、地方保健当局が殺虫剤散布や幼虫対策などの通常の対応を実施中。死亡者数が限定的で国際的な懸念は低いが、症例数の急増傾向は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: [BREAKING] Ebola: NCDC approves N100,000 weekly payment for contacts
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's Ebola outbreak in Abuja: one confirmed case as of 25 Oct 2026, imported from Uganda; Bundibugyo strain. Symptoms began Oct 7; sought care Oct 11; confirmed Oct 20. 53 primary contacts identified under 21-day monitoring (healthcare workers, household members, domestic staff, sample collectors). Nigerian authorities approved emergency payment of N100,000 per person per week to cover accommodation and feeding for contacts in isolation or quarantine, to prevent financial hardship and ensure compliance with monitoring. The measure was announced by NCDC Director-General Dr Jide Idris. WHO identifies the case as imported; investigations continue to identify exposure source. Regional outbreak affects DRC and Kenya; Nigeria strengthens IPC, surveillance, and cross-state preparedness, urging verified information and cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: 【速報】エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリア疾病対策センター（NCDC）、接触者への週10万ナイラの手当支給を承認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア（アブジャ）でウガンダ由来の輸入エボラ確定症例が発生し、53人の接触者が21日間の経過観察下にあるなど、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）での輸入エボラ症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは地域流行の一環として実際に感染が確認されている国として言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: Faesp reforça prevenção em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: FAESP strengthens prevention in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease focus in Santa Catarina prompts reinforced biosafety in São Paulo. Faesp/Senar mobilized rural unions after a Newcastle disease outbreak was confirmed on Oct 18 at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina. A 60-day zoosanitary emergency was declared in Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas and Nova Erechim; depopulation at the affected site was completed on Oct 20, with ongoing cleaning, disinfection, epidemiological surveillance and movement controls. Imports were restricted: Malaysia and Mexico halted some Brazilian poultry products; Saudi Arabia, China and Chile restricted certain Santa Catarina-origin categories. FAESP advocates regionalizing sanitary measures to limit economic impact on other states. In São Paulo, poultry production highlights prevention: 2025 eggs total 14.98 billion (25.2% of Brazil); H1 2026 eggs 7.32 billion. Broiler slaughter: 2025 753.8 million birds; H1 2026 382.1 million; exports about US$545.5 million.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：FAESPがサンパウロ州で予防策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 家きん（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病流行であり、人への健康被害は報告されていない。ブラジル国内で防疫措置・移動制限・殺処分が完了し、管理下にある動物疾病イベント。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家きん（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病流行で、ヒトへの感染・健康影響の報告はない。複数国がブラジル産家きん製品の輸入を一部制限しているが、発生国（ブラジル）内で防疫対応（60日間の緊急事態宣言、殺処分、消毒、移動制限）が実施済み。中国・マレーシア・サウジアラビア・チリ等は貿易制限の対象国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Uganda Announces 21-Day Quarantine For Returnees From DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 25, 2026, Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine for returnees from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), at their own cost, with intensified screening at Entebbe International Airport and land border crossings. The DRC has recorded more than 4,600 Ebola deaths since declaring its 17th outbreak in May; the Bundibugyo strain drives the current outbreak, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda had been declared Ebola-free by the WHO in August after 20 cases, largely linked to visits to DRC. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes severe haemorrhagic fever. Nigeria’s first Ebola case, a woman who arrived in Abuja from Uganda, is recovering; genomic sequencing ties Nigeria’s virus to a Kenyan-imported strain, differing by a single mutation, with only one confirmed Nigerian case and ongoing contact tracing. Kenya reports two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者に21日間の隔離措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月以降4,600人超の死者を出す第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・特効薬なし）が継続し、ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアへの国際的拡大と渡航制限（隔離措置）が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでの症例・死亡も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。発生源・主流行地であるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda unveils 21-day quarantine for returnees from DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine for returnees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, at personal cost, with intensified screening at Entebbe International Airport, land borders, and road checkpoints (as of 25 October 2026). The DRC Ebola outbreak, its 17th since May, has killed more than 4,600; the Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola is transmitted via contact with bodily fluids and causes severe haemorrhagic fever; about 15,000 Africans have died from Ebola over the last five decades. Uganda was declared Ebola-free by the WHO in August after 20 cases and two deaths, largely among visitors from DRC. Kenya has reported two Ebola deaths; Nigeria confirmed its first case in October—a woman who arrived in Abuja on a flight from Uganda. Ugandan officials reject that Uganda caused Nigeria’s case, citing zero current Ebola cases in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者に21日間の検疫を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（2026年5月以降17回目、死者4,600人超）が国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題であるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの発生源はDRCであり、対象国リストに含まれる。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは感染拡大先として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、致死率が高い点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Doenças infecciosas aumentam com mudanças climáticas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious diseases increase with climate change.
article.articleSummary: Climate change expands dengue transmission to cooler Brazilian regions and into the Northern Hemisphere, with the United States facing its largest dengue outbreak and autochthonous cases reported in France and Italy. In Brazil, Rio Grande do Sul logged nearly 210,000 confirmed dengue infections and 281 deaths in 2024; Bahia recorded about 163,000 cases and 188 deaths. A Fiocruz analysis (2006–2024) shows dengue epidemic microrregions rising from 110 to 292 (about 54% of the country), while 46% show medium-to-low incidence. The expansion correlates with anomalous temperature patterns, suggesting irreversibility of transmission zones. El Niño is forecast to affect Brazil, potentially amplifying extremes. Other climate-linked threats include Oropouche fever with over 12,000 infections in 2023 across 23 states and the Federal District; leptospirosis after floods; hantavirus outbreaks linked to wildfires; and emerging fungal pathogens adapting to higher temperatures.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動により感染症が増加
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動とデング熱等の感染症拡大傾向に関する分析記事であり、2024年までの既知データの振り返りが中心で新規の急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではないが、デング熱の疾病負荷拡大や新規地域への浸潤は継続的に注視すべき傾向である。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動とデング熱・オロプーシュ熱・レプトスピラ症・ハンタウイルス感染症などの関連性を論じるレビュー的内容で、主要なデータはブラジル国内（リオグランデドスル州、バイーア州）のもの。米国・フランス・イタリアも言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。特定の新規アウトブレイクを示すものではなく、トレンド分析として継続的な経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: УГАНДА ПОOШТРАВА МЕРЕ ЗБОГ ЕБОЛЕ: За повратнике из Конга обавезан карантин од 21 дан
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Tightens Ebola Measures: 21-day quarantine mandatory for returnees from Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day mandatory quarantine for returnees from the Democratic Republic of Congo as part of tightened Ebola controls. As of 25 October 2026, authorities say Uganda remains Ebola-free, noting the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak was declared over on 28 July 2026. Border controls at Entebbe International Airport and all land borders have been strengthened; entrants by air, land, or water must complete travel and residence forms. The Health Ministry reported that 60 contacts of an infected person from Kenya completed 21 days of health surveillance without symptoms and were released. Uganda is also investigating a possible Ebola case in Nigeria involving a woman who traveled from Uganda, with genome analysis and contact tracing conducted in collaboration with Nigerian authorities and international partners. In Kenya, a second Ebola death was confirmed: a 65-year-old woman died while in quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対策を強化：コンゴからの帰国者に21日間の検疫を義務化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）を発生源とするエボラ関連の懸念から、ウガンダが国境管理・検疫を強化し、ケニアでの死亡例、ナイジェリアでの疑い例調査など複数国にまたがる動きが見られるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの対応を中心に述べているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCは帰国者の出発国としてエボラ発生の文脈に関連するため含めた。DRC国内での具体的な症例数や発生状況についての直接記述はなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: BREAKING: NCDC Reports 2 New Ebola Suspected Cases, 53 Contacts
article.articleSummary: Two additional suspected Ebola virus disease cases and 53 primary contacts are linked to the confirmed case in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory. The confirmed case is a diplomat who traveled from Uganda to Abuja on 3 October, developed malaria-like symptoms on 7 October, and was admitted to a private hospital on 11 October. She tested on 19 October and was confirmed positive on 20 October. Laboratory analyses by the NCDC and WHO confirmed the Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. At confirmation, 44 close contacts were identified; surveillance and contact tracing have since been intensified, with 53 primary contacts including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, travel contacts, and her husband. The patient's condition deteriorated to multi-organ failure and she remains in isolation. The DRC outbreak since May has caused over 4,600 deaths from over 9,000 cases and spread to Uganda and Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：ナイジェリアCDC、新たに2件のエボラ疑い例と53人の接触者を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が既に9,000例・4,600人超の死者を出しており、国際的な拡大（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの波及）が確認されているため、IHR基準2つ以上に該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる事例はナイジェリア（対象国外）だが、背景として記述されているDRCの大規模エボラ流行（5月以降9,000例超・4,600人超死亡）は対象国リストに含まれるため計上。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : un infirmier pris pour cible et tué sur fond de rumeur à Bafwasende
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: a nurse targeted and killed amid rumors in Bafwasende
article.articleSummary: In Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola violence against health workers intensifies as of 24 October 2026. A nurse and a primary school principal, both Ebola response agents, were attacked by youths near Bafwasende General Hospital; the nurse died on the spot and the principal was severely injured. The assailants accused them of spreading the virus in a water source. Docteur Likilo Marcel notes a rise in attacks on health responders, following earlier incidents including arson at a community relay and an assault on a nurse’s child. Officials warn such violence could deter partners supporting the outbreak response and urge provincial authorities to deploy police or soldiers for security. The Bafwasende health zone has recorded 19 Ebola cases to date, with 9 deaths, 5 recoveries, 2 hospitalized at the CTE, and 3 additional confirmed cases that fled care, with limited community assistance to locate them.

triage.headline_ja: ツショピ州のエボラ:バフワセンデで噂をめぐり看護師が標的にされ殺害される
triage.triage_reason: DRC・バフワセンデで進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（19症例、9死亡）に加え、対応従事者への暴力や感染者の逃走など対応困難化が深刻化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 確認症例の逃走や対応従事者への暴力が報告されており、アウトブレイク制御が著しく困難化している点が懸念される。続報でWHO/現地当局の対応状況を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Nai ghi nhận ca tử vong thứ 4 do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Nai records its fourth rabies death.
article.articleSummary: Dong Nai reports its fourth rabies death in 2026. The deceased, Đ.G., 27, of Xe ethnicity, from Bình Hà hamlet, Đa Kia commune, died on 19 Oct after exposure to a stray dog that had bitten him two months earlier, causing a severe finger wound (grade III) and leading to furious rabies; he did not receive post-exposure prophylaxis. A second case linked to the same stray involved 6-year-old Đ.Y. from thôn Bù Cà Mau, Phú Nghĩa, who was bitten on the chest but had no vaccination. Local practices of free-roaming dogs, lack of muzzles/tethers, and suboptimal vaccination rates raise ongoing risk. CDC Đồng Nai, with Bu Gia Map District Health Center, Đa Kia authorities, and veterinary services, implemented containment: area disinfection, vaccine/antigen campaigns around the index case, and outreach to encourage vaccination and timely post-exposure treatment. A dog/cat vaccination drive targets >80% coverage.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省、狂犬病による4人目の死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ドンナイ省で狂犬病による死亡が年間4例目となり、野良犬の放し飼いや予防接種率の低さなど継続的なリスクが示唆されるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念はなく、国内の地方レベルでの通常対応に留まるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ベトナムでは狂犬病は地域的に流行しており、今回の事例も地方自治体・CDCによる通常の封じ込め対応（消毒、ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が実施されている。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないが、野良犬対策や曝露後予防（PEP）未実施者の存在など、継続的なリスク要因があるため今後の動向を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: From night sweats to unexplained weight loss, 10 tuberculosis symptoms you should not ignore
article.articleSummary: TB in India remains a major public health challenge, with India accounting for about one-quarter of the world’s TB burden as of 2026-10-25. Early detection relies on recognizing a constellation of symptoms rather than a single sign. Ten key symptoms are highlighted: cough lasting more than two weeks (dry or with phlegm); blood in sputum; chest pain; shortness of breath; fever (often low-grade and evening rises); night sweats; unintentional weight loss; loss of appetite; fatigue; and swelling in the neck or other extrapulmonary signs such as gland, bone, joint, or abdominal involvement. Testing and treatment are available free of charge at government facilities nationwide, with additional screening through Ayushman Arogya Shivirs health camps in every district. TB is curable, and earlier diagnosis improves outcomes for patients and the wider community.

triage.headline_ja: 寝汗から原因不明の体重減少まで、見逃してはいけない結核の10の症状
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な結核症状の啓発記事であり、特定の発生事例や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の症状啓発に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、具体的な発生状況・流行・異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Breaking: NCDC Pays N100,000 Weekly to People Monitored for Ebola
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's NCDC began paying N100,000 per person weekly to individuals under Ebola monitoring in Abuja after a confirmed case. The emergency, not budgeted, covers accommodation and feeding as contacts face financial strain; the arrangement will be reviewed. On Oct 25, 2026, 53 primary contacts were identified, including healthcare workers, household members, domestic staff and laboratory personnel who handled the patient. One contact developed symptoms but tested negative; surveillance continues through the 21-day incubation period. The confirmed case is a woman who travelled from Uganda and was diagnosed with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola; symptoms began Oct 7, care sought Oct 11, test positive Oct 20. The WHO classifies it as imported, with investigations into exposure ongoing; a wider regional outbreak has affected the DRC and Kenya. Idris urged other states to prepare financially and logistically for potential future cases.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：NCDC、エボラ接触者監視対象者に週10万ナイラを支給
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでウガンダ由来の輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）症例が確認され、53名の接触者監視が継続中。DRC・ケニアを含む地域的アウトブレイクの一環であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（Abuja）での輸入症例対応だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは地域的アウトブレイクの一部として言及されており対象国リストに含まれるため記載。ウガンダ・ケニアも言及あるが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo inicia ensayo de vacunas contra el ébola de Bundibugyo en medio de una epidemia mortal | TN8
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo begins Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine trial amid deadly epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Congo begins Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine trial amid deadly epidemic. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, an outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus has caused 4,687 deaths and 9,704 laboratory-confirmed cases as of October 20, 2026. The first doses of the Tumaini trial—Swahili for 'hope'—were given on October 23 in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in eastern DRC. The Phase 2/3 study aims to evaluate the safety and efficacy of multiple vaccine candidates, focusing on individuals with recent exposure to infected patients. Chikwe Ihekweazu of the World Health Organization Emergency Programme emphasized the trial's role in determining whether experimental vaccines can prevent Bundibugyo virus infection. Findings will inform future outbreak response and prevention strategies for this Ebola variant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、致死的な流行の中でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスワクチン試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模な流行（死亡者4,687人、確定症例9,704人）が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOおよび国際機関（Tumaini試験）が関与しており、既存の大規模流行の継続中の対応として重要。致死率は約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达收紧伊波拉防疫措施 曾赴刚果旅客须隔离21天
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Tightens Ebola Prevention Measures; Travelers Who Have Visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo Must Quarantine for 21 Days
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens Ebola prevention measures: travelers with a history of travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo must quarantine 21 days, and all entrants by air, land, or water must complete passenger-tracking forms with strengthened airport and border screening. Uganda, which ended its latest Ebola outbreak in July, is under renewed scrutiny as Kenya and Nigeria recently confirmed cases that had passed through the country. Kenya’s first patient traveled via Entebbe International Airport on Oct 3 en route to Nairobi and died two days later. Nigeria’s case concerns the wife of a Swiss diplomat who had visited Uganda last month; Swiss authorities say she contracted the virus in Uganda, while Ugandan officials point to contacts with West Nile Region relatives who had been to the Congo. Laboratory analyses show Nigeria’s virus closely resembles the Kenyan strain; no direct contact is established. Uganda is cooperating with Nigeria and international partners to investigate travel histories, contacts, and genome sequences. Sixty Kenyan-case contacts completed 21 days of monitoring and were released.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対策を強化 コンゴ渡航歴のある旅行者に21日間の隔離を義務化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がウガンダからケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境伝播し死亡例も発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアであり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRC（コンゴ）は感染者の渡航歴・接触歴として言及されているのみで、同国内での確定症例は記事中に明示されていないためverified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC identifies two suspected Ebola cases, traces 53 primary contacts
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's NCDC reports two additional suspected Ebola virus disease cases and 53 primary contacts in ongoing containment of the first imported Nigerian case. The imported infection involves a woman who travelled from Uganda; symptoms began Oct 7, she arrived in Nigeria and sought care Oct 11. Laboratory confirmation identified Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease; genomic analysis linked the virus to a strain detected in Kenya but with no confirmed direct epidemiological link. As of Oct 25, 2026, 53 primary contacts have been identified: 44 from the health facility where she was treated and nine others—three household members, driver, chef, and husband—plus three team members who collected samples. Two additional suspected cases are awaiting laboratory confirmation. The government continues enhanced surveillance, isolation, and infection prevention; WHO urges strengthened surveillance amid a broader Bundibugyo outbreak in DRC with cases also reported in Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアCDC、エボラ出血熱の疑い例2件を新たに確認、濃厚接触者53人を追跡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの広範なブンディブギョ型エボラ流行を背景に、ナイジェリアへの輸入症例と濃厚接触者の拡大が確認されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入エボラ症例（渡航元はウガンダ）だが、対象国リストにナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは含まれない。背景として言及されているDRCでの広範なブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が対象国リストに該当するため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Zdolávání afrického moru prasat v Číně | Náš chov - vše o chovu hospodářských zvířat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tackling African Swine Fever in China | Our Livestock - All About Farm Animal Husbandry
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak in China began with the first confirmed case on 3 August 2018 in Shenyang, Liaoning, and rapidly spread across the country. The epidemic reduced the sow population by about 30% and pork production by roughly 40%, triggering a three-year government plan to control ASF and restore output. The sector restructured toward larger, highly biosecure farms and five regional zones, with tighter live-pig movements and a shift toward local slaughterhouses and cold-chain pork. Genetic analysis linked the virus to Georgia 2007 lineage; introduction likely via live pigs or products, though the exact route remains unproven. No widely approved vaccine exists; Korean vaccines are available but carry risks, and field use abroad has regulatory caveats. China enforces extreme biosecurity: PCR screening, hygiene, decontamination, and vehicle/material controls; large farms account for 38% of production, mid-sized 33%, smaller farms the rest. Pork prices rose, boosting imports.

triage.headline_ja: 中国におけるアフリカ豚熱（ASF）対策
triage.triage_reason: 2018年に発生した過去のASF流行に関する回顧的・分析的な記事であり、現在進行中の新規公衆衛生イベントではないため、トリアージ対象としない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2018年8月に発生した中国のASF流行とその後の業界再編・対策についての回顧的分析記事であり、新規または進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。また対象疾患は動物疾病（ASF）であり人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの直接的健康影響は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo : quatre nouveaux survivants d'Ebola quittent le centre de traitement de Matanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: Four new Ebola survivors leave the Matanda treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola survivors were discharged from the Matanda Ebola Treatment Center in Butembo, North Kivu, on 24 October 2026, bringing Matanda’s total cures to 29 since its 23 September opening. The group includes two women and two men; among them Kyakimwa Kavutirwaki Micheline, a clinical psychologist who contracted Ebola while caring for patients, spent 24 days at Matanda after presenting diarrhea and fever. She urged the community to take the disease seriously and called on health workers to maintain protective measures. Matanda’s physician, Dr. Nzanzu Furaha Blaise Pascal, thanked patients, staff, and the International Medical Corps (IMC). In Katwa, six cures were reported for 19–23 October, with three non-cases. As of 22 October, Nord-Kivu had 2,291 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,325 deaths (58% fatality); Katwa 685/442, Beni 576/403, Butembo 351/196, with 658 active and 265 recovered province-wide. Overall, 2,635 cures in Ituri and Nord-Kivu out of 9,816 cases.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ：マタンダ治療センターからエボラ生存者4名が退所
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州・イトゥリ州で継続中の大規模エボラ流行（計9,816症例、致死率約58%の地域あり）に関する続報であり、深刻な公衆衛生インパクトと国際的拡大リスクを有するため。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の大規模エボラ流行（北キブ州・イトゥリ州）の継続報告であり、国際医療支援団体（IMC）が関与。致死率が非常に高く（北キブ州58%）、既に国際的な注目と支援を受けている進行中の公衆衛生危機である。

article.articleHeadline: On High Alert: Uganda Imposes Strict Ebola Quarantine After Airport Transit Cases Emerge
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine for Ugandan citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo as border controls tighten against Ebola; Entebbe and land crossings have intensified screening and require passenger locator forms. Although Uganda declared itself Ebola-free in July, cross-border cases emerged after two travelers later tested positive in Kenya and Nigeria. The Kenyan patient, who traveled Congo→Uganda, then flew Entebbe to Nairobi on Oct 3 and died Oct 5. The Nigerian case involves the wife of a Swiss diplomat who visited Uganda; genomic analysis shows the virus closely matches the Kenyan strain, though Nigerian authorities say she did not travel to Kenya or contact the patient. Security footage showed no interaction between the two. Sixty contacts linked to the Kenyan patient completed 21-day monitoring. Congo’s Bundibugyo outbreak has 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths (as of Oct 20), prompting vaccines trials (Ervebo in Bunia; Moderna, Oxford/Serum Institute candidates) to proceed.

triage.headline_ja: 厳戒態勢：空港での感染者発生を受け、ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の厳格な検疫措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）発のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（9,704症例、4,687死亡）が国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大し、空路での感染者発生と死亡例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な国際公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアでの症例発生が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。アウトブレイクの発生源であるDRC（Bundibugyo）のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: UPDATED: Ebola: Nigeria identifies 53 contacts linked to confirmed case
article.articleSummary: 53 primary contacts linked to Nigeria's confirmed Ebola case in Abuja's FCT: 44 health-facility staff and nine others (three household members, the patient’s driver, chef and husband, plus three sample-collection team members who attended Julius Berger Clinic). No contacts have tested positive or shown symptoms as of the briefing. Investigations include the confirmed FCT case and a Rivers State suspected case, both negative. The confirmed patient tested positive on three samples; her husband tested negative. Contact tracing continues with 21-day monitoring; numbers may change as investigations progress. Nigeria is strengthening Ebola preparedness with about 12 laboratories capable of testing and the National Reference Laboratory coordinating testing; health worker training on infection prevention and control. An imported FCT case on Oct 20 involves a 42-year-old Ugandan-born Abuja resident who recently returned from Kampala; genomic analysis shows high similarity to Kenya's first imported case, though there is no evidence she was infected in Kenya. Kenya’s first case was imported from the DRC via Uganda; Kenya has nine confirmed cases and two deaths, with eight additional infections linked to the index case.

triage.headline_ja: 【更新】エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリア、確認症例に関連する接触者53人を特定
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで確定したエボラ症例が、ウガンダ・ケニア・DRCにまたがる感染連鎖の一部である可能性が示唆されており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断する。
triage.notes: 本イベントはナイジェリア（Abuja/FCT）、ケニア、ウガンダに関連する感染連鎖であり、DRCは感染経路の言及（ケニア症例がDRC経由でウガンダから感染）に留まり、DRC国内での発生事例ではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国はない。ただし国際的な感染拡大パターン（複数国にまたがるゲノム類似性）が確認されており、監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: EBOLA IN NIGERIA -- The Fate of a Distrusting Nation Facing General Elections, by Alaba Yusuf
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease imported case in Nigeria (Abuja) announced Oct 21, 2026 by the NCDC: a woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat, arrived Oct 5 via Addis Ababa and tested positive for Bundibugyo, a strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. About 46 contacts, mostly healthcare workers, have been identified; her husband is among them. No other symptomatic individuals reported. The Bundibugyo strain has reportedly killed over 4,600 people since May across the DRC, Uganda and Kenya, making Nigeria the fourth country affected and Africa's most geographically complex Ebola outbreak to date. The piece links distrust to delayed reporting and misperceptions about isolation and case counts. The 21-day follow-up and contact tracing face challenges in a country with crowded markets, religious centers, and rallies. With January 2027 elections, governance and public health messaging must be led by scientists to preserve trust, and authorities deny using Ebola to influence polls.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ出血熱―総選挙を控えた不信の国家の運命（アラバ・ユスフ）

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 cases at 82 in Bhopal; docs urge caution amid seasonal respiratory concerns
article.articleSummary: 82 H1N1 cases in Bhopal, eight new infections taking the tally to 82; dengue cases exceed 150 in the city. Chief medical and health officer says no patient is in critical condition. Seasonal changes and Diwali cleaning are aggravating respiratory symptoms; Gandhi Medical College’s pulmonary outpatient department sees about 150–170 patients daily, with roughly 100 cases linked to weather changes. Dust, pollen, smoke and cold air irritate airways, particularly in asthma patients or those with pre-existing conditions. Authorities urge measures to curb mosquito breeding by preventing water stagnation around homes. People with fever, body aches or breathing problems should consult a doctor rather than self-medicating. Precautions include wearing a well-fitting N95 mask during cleaning, damp cleaning methods, avoiding irritants, continuing inhalers, and limiting outdoor activity when pollution or dust levels are high, with medical care sought for worsening symptoms.

article.articleHeadline: Competing-risk analysis of tuberculosis outcomes in Liangshan
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) outcomes among people living with HIV in Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan, China were analyzed using competing-risk methods. In 340 closed TB treatment episodes, the 12-month cumulative incidence of an unfavorable outcome was 7.96% (95% CI 5.30–10.91%), with most events early (4.41% at 3 months; 55.5% of the 12-month total by 3 months). Cures or treatment completion occurred in 303/340 (89.1%), while 27 (7.9%) had unfavorable outcomes and 10 (2.9%) were administratively censored. Unfavorable outcomes were dominated by non-TB deaths (22/27; 81.5%), with transfer to MDR-TB treatment counted as unfavorable. Older age increased risk: in the full model, every 10-year age increment raised subdistribution hazard roughly 1.54–1.70 (p=0.004–0.039); cause-specific hazards yielded ~1.73 (p=0.003). The cohort was predominantly Yi (97.6%), male (76.5%), mean age 41.0 years; TB-specific mortality could not be distinguished due to data limitations.

article.articleHeadline: वायरल संक्रमण की मार, जन आरोग्य मेले में पहुंचे मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The toll of viral infections; patients arrive at the Public Health Fair.
article.articleSummary: On 25 October 2026, Prayagraj district reports rising viral infections amid seasonal changes, as the Public Health Fair screens residents at 62 primary health centers. A total of 1,354 patients were tested and provided medicines; the majority exhibited viral fever, with many also presenting cold, cough, arthritis, and skin conditions, attributed to ongoing weather changes. At Mandah PHC, 35 patients were examined; Urban PHC Kundaa was overseen by Deputy CMO Dr. Rajesh Kumar; Diwan Ganj and Diliipur PHCs reported 38 and 42 rural patients respectively. About half of rural attendees showed viral infection symptoms. In a parallel screening across PHCs Poore Noiti, Raniganj Cathola, and Paharpur, 116 individuals were evaluated for anemia, diabetes, blood pressure, heart and abdominal diseases, skin conditions, TB, and liver disease, with 47, 31, and 38 patients receiving free medicines. Health staff also advised preventive measures to attendees.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性のウイルス性感染症（風邪・発熱等）に関する地域の定期健康診断イベントの報道であり、結核を含む慢性疾患スクリーニングの一環。重大・異常な公衆衛生事象とは言えず、国際的拡大の懸念もない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda exige 21 días de cuarentena a ciudadanos que regresen de la RD del Congo tras detectarse nuevos casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine on citizens returning from the DRC after new Ebola cases were detected.
article.articleSummary: On 25 October 2026, Uganda announced a 21-day quarantine for Ugandan nationals returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) who have travel history to the DRC, amid an Ebola outbreak linked to cases detected in multiple countries. The quarantine length reflects the Ebola incubation period, with individuals bearing the cost of the measure. Border movement is restricted to essential travelers, including humanitarian workers and commercial truck drivers. The policy follows Nigeria confirming an imported Ebola case tied to a Ugandan-origin Swiss citizen who had vacationed in Uganda before returning to Nigeria. The response underscores ongoing cross-border risk from the DRC-driven Ebola situation and Uganda’s use of border controls and quarantine to mitigate importation and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者にエボラ新規症例検出を受け21日間の検疫を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ流行が国境を越えてウガンダ・ナイジェリアにも波及しており、IHR基準（深刻性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。

article.articleHeadline: 類流感病例上升8% 疫苗將於下週推出
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza-like illness cases rise by 8%; vaccine to be rolled out next week.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 25, 2026, the Ministry of Health of a country reported an 8% weekly rise in influenza-like illness (ILI) cases, with 11,137 cases recorded this week versus 12,780 cases in the Sep 3–16 period. The ministry notes that cumulative ILI cases from January through last week remain below the total for the same period in 2025. WHO defines ILI as fever plus cough or other respiratory symptoms, caused by multiple pathogens; transmission occurs via respiratory droplets from coughing or sneezing and contact with contaminated surfaces. Cases typically increase in colder weather when people gather indoors for festivities. The health minister announced that influenza vaccination will be rolled out next week, prioritizing vulnerable groups.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ様疾患の通常範囲内の増加であり、累積症例数は前年同期を下回っている。重篤性や異常性を示す情報もなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーには具体的な発生国名が明記されていないが、記事出典（shangbao.com.ph）およびBluedot付与地域からフィリピンの可能性が高い。ただし本文中に国名の明示的記載がなく確証が持てないため、verified_locationsは空とした。季節性ILIの通常変動であり、ワクチン接種計画も既存の公衆衛生対応の一環と判断。

article.articleHeadline: * prevenção da raiva - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Prevention - Jornal Panorama
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention is highlighted by the Municipal Health Secretariat of Bom Jesus do Amparo. The guidance emphasizes that rabies is a serious disease affecting dogs, cats, and humans, with infection often fatal after symptoms appear. Transmission occurs through contact with saliva of infected animals, with major exposures including bites, scratches, and licking of wounds or mucous membranes. Rabies vaccination for dogs and cats is a key preventive measure to protect both animal and human health; residents should keep their pets' vaccines up to date. Preventing rabies also safeguards people who live with animals by reducing transmission risk. For vaccination guidance and rabies prevention information, residents can contact the health department at (31) 3822-1200. Published by Jornal Panorama, based on information from the Prefeitura de Bom Jesus do Amparo. As of 25 October 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Plague risks in Russia and a dangerous delay on WHO pandemic agreement
article.articleSummary: Plague in Russia’s Siberia, where a worker died at a plague research institute, highlights information-sharing gaps and the fragility of outbreak response six years after Covid. The piece ties this to the WHO pandemic agreement’s pathogen access and benefit-sharing annex, where poorer countries seek binding guarantees—about 20% of real-time vaccine and treatment production, with half donated and half sold at cost—in exchange for rapid detection and sharing; richer countries prefer voluntary arrangements, delaying signature to 2027. It critiques the International Health Regulations’ 24-hour notification rule for lacking verification, sanctions, or independent monitoring, and notes an advisory implementation committee. The editorial recalls 1894 Hong Kong plague investigations (Kitasato vs Yersin) to illustrate access disputes. It urges the UK to propose independent verification and a public compliance register, and to join the Universal Health and Preparedness Review, ahead of the May 2027 assembly.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアにおけるペストのリスクとWHOパンデミック協定の危険な遅延
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシア・シベリアのペスト研究所での死亡例を契機にWHOパンデミック協定交渉の政治的課題を論じる論説記事であり、対象国における実際の感染症発生事例ではない。
triage.notes: ロシアは対象国リストに含まれず、記事中の香港・中国への言及は1894年の歴史的事例（北里柴三郎とイェルサンのペスト菌発見論争）の引用であり、現在の発生地ではない。記事はWHOパンデミック協定交渉やIHR制度の課題を論じる論説であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de João Pessoa chama atenção para importância da prevenção contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: João Pessoa City Hall highlights the importance of measles prevention.
article.articleSummary: Measles remains a public health concern in João Pessoa, Paraíba, Brazil, though no confirmed cases have been recorded since 2019. With measles circulating in other American countries, authorities stress intensified vaccination to prevent reintroduction. The virus is highly contagious: a single infected person can transmit to up to 18 susceptible people, airborne for up to two hours in enclosed spaces. Common symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and a red rash that starts on the face and spreads. Complications can be severe, such as pneumonia, encephalitis, ear infections, diarrhea, and vision impairment, with higher risk in young children, malnourished individuals, and immunocompromised people. Vaccination via SUS is free. First dose of the MMR vaccine for 12-month-olds rose from 69.69% (2024) to 84.61% (2026), still below the 95% target; second dose coverage remains incomplete. The schedule: first dose at 12 months, second dose at 15 months (tetraviral); boosters urged for all ages, especially health workers, who must have two doses.

triage.headline_ja: ジョアン・ペソア市役所、麻疹予防の重要性を呼びかけ
