triage.notes: 記事は確認症例のない予防啓発キャンペーンに関するもので、対象国（Brazil含む）での実際の流行報告ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Azzaman daily newspaperجريدة الزمان - عربية يومية دولية مستقلة | Azzaman International daily newspaperتجربة سريرية للقاح ضد إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine in Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the first Ebola vaccine clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to address the outbreak. In Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in northern DRC, the Tomaini trial began with the first participant receiving a vaccine dose. The outbreak is described as the worst in DRC history, with more than 9,700 infections and over 4,600 deaths. Tomaini is a unified trial framework to test the safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity of several vaccines, using a ring vaccination approach that targets contacts at highest risk. The study will also test Ervebo, approved for Zaire ebolavirus, for potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain driving this outbreak, for which no vaccines or therapies are approved. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in early trials—Oxford-developed and Moderna's mRNA candidate. The trial will include pregnant women and children aged 12 and older.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラワクチンの臨床試験
triage.triage_reason: DRCの歴史上最悪とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行で、感染9700人超・死亡4600人超という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、WHOが新規ワクチン臨床試験を開始するなど国際的な対応が進行中であるため。
triage.notes: 本件はコンゴ民主共和国(イトゥリ州ブニア)で発生中のエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)流行に対するWHO主導の新規ワクチン臨床試験(Tomaini試験)に関する報道であり、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの一環として継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda reforça medidas contra Ebola e impõe quarentena de 21 dias a cidadãos que retornam do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda steps up measures against Ebola and imposes a 21-day quarantine on citizens returning from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 October 2026, Uganda tightens Ebola measures, ordering a 21-day quarantine for Ugandan citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and expanding border screening, including at Entebbe International Airport. The policy follows two travelers who transited through Uganda and later tested positive in Kenya and Nigeria. Uganda maintains there is no local transmission, linking cases to the Congo and continuing contact tracing. The Nigerian case involves the wife (42) of a Swiss diplomat who returned to Abuja from Uganda via Addis Ababa on 3 October; she is isolated and improving, with 53 contacts traced. Genomic sequencing and travel-history analyses are underway in coordination with Nigeria and international partners. The Kenyan case had traveled from Congo to Uganda, then Entebbe to Nairobi on 3 October and died two days later; both Kenya and Nigeria cases passed through Entebbe the same day with no confirmed direct interaction per CCTV. Kenya reported 60 contacts completed 21-day monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対策を強化しコンゴからの帰国者に21日間の検疫を義務化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を起点としたエボラ感染者がウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでの関連症例は確認されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染源であるDRCのみを計上。国際的な渡航関連エボラ拡大事例として重大性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda imposes 21-day quarantine on Congo travellers
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine for Ugandan citizens returning from countries with a DRC travel history as Ebola precautions tighten. Two Ebola cases detected in Kenya and Nigeria have travelled via Entebbe International Airport, triggering border screening. Uganda says it is Ebola-free after ending its latest outbreak in July, but genomic sequencing and movements are being reviewed with Nigerian authorities. Nigeria’s confirmed case involves the wife of a Swiss diplomat who visited Uganda; Swiss authorities say she contracted there, while Baryomunsi questions this. Kenya’s patient travelled from the DRC to Uganda and then flew Entebbe to Nairobi, dying Oct 5; CCTV found no direct interaction at Entebbe between the Kenyan and Nigerian cases. Genomic analysis links Nigeria’s strain to Kenya’s case; Nigeria says there’s no evidence the Kenyan patient travelled to Nigeria. All 60 contacts from the Kenyan case completed 21-day monitoring; passenger locator forms are in place.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ(DRC)からの渡航者に21日間の検疫を義務化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCを起点にウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大し、渡航制限（検疫）措置が取られていることが確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア間でのエボラ感染連鎖だが、これら対象国リストに含まれないためDRC（渡航歴の起点国）のみをverified_locationsに記載。ゲノム解析によりケニア・ナイジェリアの症例間に関連が示唆されており、国際的拡大の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls and requires returnees from Congo to pay for quarantine
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls, requiring citizens returning from Congo to undergo 21 days of quarantine at their own expense, as investigators examine how a woman who traveled from Uganda to Nigeria contracted Ebola. The investigation follows an Ebola outbreak in Congo that has killed thousands, though Uganda has had no confirmed cases since declaring its outbreak over on July 28. Since May, Uganda has restricted non-essential travel and implemented border screening. The new policy increases pressure on returnees from Congo and relates to an imported/exported risk, with the Nigeria-linked case under investigation. Authorities continue surveillance and border control measures to prevent reintroduction, amid ongoing concerns about cross-border transmission as of 2026-10-25.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対策で国境管理を強化し、コンゴからの帰国者に検疫費用負担を義務付け
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続くエボラ流行に関連し、ナイジェリアでウガンダ経由の感染者が確認されるなど越境拡大の兆候があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ流行とその越境リスクであり、ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ナイジェリアでの感染者発生はコンゴ由来の越境例として国際的拡大リスクを示唆する重要情報。

article.articleHeadline: Four Recover From Ebola in Butembo, North Kivi - Taarifa Rwanda:
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola patients were discharged from the Matanda Ebola Treatment Center at Matanda Secondary Referral Hospital in North Kivu’s Butembo area, bringing total recoveries at the facility to 29 since its opening on September 23. The four adults—two women and two men—presented diarrhea and fever; among them is Kyakimwa Kavutirwaki Micheline, a clinical psychologist who contracted the disease while caring for patients at a health facility and spent 24 days at Matanda ETC. Hospital officials quoted Dr. Nzanzu Furaha Blaise Pascal noting the tally rose from 25 to 29 with these discharges. In Butembo City, the Katwa Ebola Treatment Center reported six cures and three non-cases during the week of October 19–23, with discharges on October 19, 21, and 23, indicating active management of ongoing Ebola cases in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州ブテンボで4人がエボラから回復 - Taarifa Rwanda
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のDRC北キブ州エボラアウトブレイクに関する継続報告であり、エボラは公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有する疾患のためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は回復・治療進捗に関する内容だが、進行中のエボラアウトブレイクの一部であり継続監視対象。医療従事者の感染例も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Youth power joins march towards a TB-free Bharat
article.articleSummary: India reduced new TB cases by 21% from 2015 to 2024 and TB deaths by 28%, with treatment coverage rising to 92% in 2024. Incidence fell from 237 to 187 per lakh; India still accounts for about a quarter of global TB cases, with roughly 27.1 lakh new cases and over 3 lakh deaths in 2024. Under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, over 28.1 crore people were screened, more than 20 lakh given TB Preventive Treatment, and 5.7 lakh new Nikshay Mitras enrolled; 46,118 Gram Panchayats achieved TB-free certification. The JOSH initiative, launched Oct 8, 2026, deploys 58,000 volunteers in 55 districts across 11 states, pairing MY Bharat volunteers with NCC cadets and a Class-I officer to expand screening and adherence. A push began Oct 13; Ni-kshay Sampark helpline 1800-11-6666 and TB Aarogya Sathi app support testing and guidance. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, mainly the lungs, spread airborne; latent infections occur.

triage.headline_ja: 青年の力がTBフリー・バーラトへの行進に参加
triage.triage_reason: 結核の罹患率・死亡率は低下傾向にあり、政府主導の啓発・対策プログラムの進捗を伝える内容であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態ではない。
triage.notes: 政府の結核撲滅キャンペーン（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, JOSH）の進捗報告記事であり、既知の慢性疾患の継続的な対策活動を扱う内容。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls and requires returnees from Congo to pay for quarantine - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls and imposes a 21‑day quarantine at the traveler’s expense for returnees from Congo, with intensified screening at Entebbe and land borders as Congo’s outbreak—previously killing thousands—persists. Uganda, which says it has had no confirmed cases since July 28, restricts Congolese travel and will return nonessential travelers at their own expense; those entering illegally face prosecution. All arrivals, including diplomats and UN personnel, must complete a passenger locator form and undergo health screening. Investigations are examining how a woman who traveled Uganda→Nigeria contracted Ebola; Nigeria’s first patient’s link to Congo remains under review, with genomic findings being assessed. Africa CDC notes both Nigeria and Kenya patients passed through Entebbe on Oct 3. Kenya’s 40-year-old man in Congo died Oct 5; eight contacts tested positive, and a close relative died, raising Kenya’s death toll to two. Uganda has deployed Bundibugyo Ebola experts to Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対策で国境管理を強化、コンゴからの帰国者に検疫費用負担を要求
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ(DRC)で継続中のエボラ流行がナイジェリア・ケニアへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準4項目・WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当する重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生源はコンゴ(DRC)での継続中のエボラ流行。ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、ケニアへの波及が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。Africa CDCが関与し国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Tightens Ebola Border Controls and Requires Returnees From Congo to Pay for Quarantine
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls, requiring citizens returning from Congo to spend 21 days in quarantine at their own expense as investigators probe how a woman traveling from Uganda to Nigeria contracted the virus. With no confirmed cases since July 28, Uganda has intensified screening at Entebbe International Airport and land borders; all arrivals must complete a passenger locator form. Nonessential Congolese travelers will be returned at the nearest border crossing, and illegal entrants face prosecution, with transit via Uganda barred for those exposed to Congo. Investigators are coordinating with Nigeria and international partners to review genomic data and movements. Uganda has deployed Ebola experts to Congo to contain the Bundibugyo strain. Kenya’s first patient, a Kenyan man living in Congo who traveled through Uganda to Kenya, died Oct 5; eight contacts tested positive, bringing Kenya’s toll to two.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対策で国境管理を強化、コンゴからの帰国者に検疫費用の自己負担を義務付け
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でナイジェリア・ケニアに越境し死亡例も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。発生源であるDRCのみを記載。記事はウガンダの国境管理強化が主題だが、感染拡大の起点はDRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : le manque d'eau potable complique l'application des
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: the lack of potable water complicates the implementation of the
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Butembo, a major eastern Democratic Republic of Congo city in North Kivu with about two million residents, continues amid critical potable water shortages (as of 25 October 2026). Over the past three days, many neighborhoods and several schools report intermittent water supply, hampering essential hygiene measures such as regular handwashing to prevent transmission. Residents rely on alternatives, with a jerrycan of water costing up to 500 Congolese francs, placing a heavy burden on families. The Butembo-Lubero Children's Parliament warns that lack of water in schools undermines hygiene. For patient care, decontamination and daily washing can require up to 400 litres per patient per day, though humanitarian partners report the Ebola Treatment Center is regularly supplied. Many households cannot afford hand sanitizer; authorities and partners urge urgent, expanded potable water provision to neighborhoods, schools, and public spaces to sustain prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボのエボラ出血熱：飲料水不足が対策実施を困難に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症がDRC北キブ州ブテンボで継続中であり、衛生対策の実施を妨げる飲料水不足という要因が感染拡大リスクを高めているため、フルRRAによる評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱自体は既知の継続アウトブレイクであり新規発生ではないが、飲料水不足という新たなリスク要因が感染対策を妨げている点が重要。治療センターへの供給は維持されているとの情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تفرض حجرًا صحيًا 21 يومًا على المواطنين العائدين من الكونغو.. ما القصة؟ |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine on citizens returning from Congo… What’s the story?
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine on Ugandan citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo to bolster Ebola prevention. Although Ebola-free since July, authorities report two recent infections in Kenya and Nigeria linked to travelers who passed through Uganda, prompting an investigation into a Nigeria case involving a Swiss diplomat’s wife who visited last month. Uganda is reviewing viral sequencing, travel histories, interactions, and movements in coordination with Nigerian authorities and international partners. Swiss officials say the woman contracted Ebola in Uganda; Uganda’s Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi rejects this, noting Kansanga near Kampala where relatives from the West Nile region had travelled to Congo. The Kenya case traveled from Congo to Uganda, then flew from Entebbe to Nairobi on Oct 3 and died two days later. Nigeria’s strain is closely related to Kenya’s, though Nigeria says there is no Kenyan travel link. Sixty contacts of the Kenyan case completed the 21-day monitoring. Screening at Entebbe and across borders has been intensified; all travelers must fill a Traveller Locator Form.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ帰還市民に21日間の検疫を課す…その背景は？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がウガンダを経由してケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大し、死亡例も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる舞台はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアだが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源としてコンゴ（DRC）への渡航歴が明記されているためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: SMS coleta mais de 12 mil ovos de Aedes aegypti em Três Lagoas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipal Health Department collects more than 12,000 Aedes aegypti eggs in Três Lagoas.
article.articleSummary: Três Lagoas, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, conducted week-40-2026 vector surveillance, collecting 12,975 Aedes aegypti eggs from 379 ovitrampas. The Municipal Health Department (SMS) and its Endemias and Entomology teams installed and monitored the traps, with Entomology analyzing the eggs to determine the presence and distribution of the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector. This effort supports arbovirus surveillance and prevention by pinpointing areas with higher mosquito presence and guiding targeted control actions.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局がトレス・ラゴアスでネッタイシマカの卵を12,000個以上採取
triage.triage_reason: 通常の媒介蚊サーベイランス活動の報告であり、ヒトの感染事例や異常な流行状況の記載がないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の卵採取による媒介蚊サーベイランスの定例報告であり、人の感染症例や発生拡大の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Carla Visi, ex-Cheiro de Amor, é internada com infecção em Lisboa: "Sem previsão de alta" - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carla Visi, former Cheiro de Amor member, is hospitalized with an infection in Lisbon: "No expected discharge date" - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: Carla Visi, 56, former Cheiro de Amor lead vocalist, is hospitalized in the infectious diseases ward at Santa Maria Hospital in Lisbon, Portugal, after being diagnosed with a bacterial infection. She developed a fever around 40°C shortly after a Femininaxé performance at Brazil Origem Week in Lisbon and has been hospitalized since Monday, October 19. Reported symptoms are limited to fever; no other manifestations noted. Allergies complicate treatment, with the medical team testing new medications as they pursue a precise diagnosis. No discharge date has been disclosed. Health updates are being communicated via Carla’s social channels by her, her daughter Sarah, and her husband Américo, a Portuguese nurse. The report provides no information on broader outbreaks or additional cases.

triage.headline_ja: 元チェイロ・ヂ・アモールのカルラ・ヴィジ、リスボンで感染症のため入院:「退院の見込み立たず」
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の単発の感染症入院事例であり、公衆衛生上の広がりや集団発生の兆候はなく、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 対象はポルトガル・リスボンでの個人の感染症入院事例であり、対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジル含む）での発生は確認されない。ブラジルは発症者の出身地として言及されているのみで発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vláda v Ugande nariadila 21-dňovú karanténu pre občanov vracajúcich sa z Konžskej demokratickej republiky
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ugandan government ordered a 21-day quarantine for citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Uganda ordered a 21-day quarantine for its citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to be borne at their own expense. Controls were tightened at Entebbe International Airport and at land borders and selected road checkpoints. In Uganda, 20 Ebola cases have been recorded, including two deaths, with nearly all linked to visits to the DRC. The Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported more than 4,600 deaths since May, the outbreak’s 17th Ebola epidemic. The current Uganda outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and can cause hemorrhagic fever. First October cases appeared in Kenya and Nigeria; Nigeria confirmed a case in a woman who traveled by plane from Uganda to Abuja; Ugandan authorities say transmission did not occur in Uganda, and Uganda had no active cases at the time.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ政府、コンゴ民主共和国から帰国する自国民に21日間の検疫措置を命令
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・特効薬なし）がDRCからウガンダへ越境し、さらにケニア・ナイジェリアへも波及したことが確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する深刻な国際的拡大事例である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行および越境伝播だが、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。DRCでの死者4,600人超という大規模流行が背景にある点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda orders 21-day Ebola quarantine for citizens returning from DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda orders a 21-day quarantine for citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a precaution against Ebola, even as Uganda says its Bundibugyo outbreak ended with 20 infections and 2 deaths (July). Returning Ugandans with DRC travel history must pay for quarantine; stricter checks at Entebbe Airport and land borders, with contact information forms for arrivals. The WHO notes the Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment; symptoms can appear up to 21 days. Separately, a Ugandan-born woman who married a Swiss diplomat is alleged by Nigerian authorities to have Ebola infected in Nigeria after visiting Uganda in September; Nigerian tests date Oct 20. Kenyan traveler from DRC via Uganda who died Oct 5 also tested positive in Kenya; both traveled through Entebbe on the same day, but no direct link. By Oct 20, DRC reported 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths; cross-border monitoring urged.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者に21日間のエボラ検疫を命令
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（9,704症例、4,687死亡）が継続中であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアなど複数国への越境拡大の兆候があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの検疫措置が主題だが、実際の大規模流行はDRCで発生している（9,704症例、4,687死亡）。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。DRCの死亡率が異常に高い点（CFR約48%）にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Africanews: в Уганде начаты испытания новой вакцины против Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africanews: Trials of a new Ebola vaccine have begun in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Phase I trials of a new Ebola vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus began in Masaka, southern Uganda, amid an outbreak in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. The vaccine, ChAdOx1 BDBV, was developed by Oxford University to protect against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine exists. The study plans to enroll 110 healthy volunteers and will first assess safety and the ability to provoke an immune response. Lead investigator Eugene Ruzagira of the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine said participants’ health will be monitored for a year after vaccination. First doses were administered on 6 October, and recruitment is expected to be completed by November. The trial's initiation reflects urgent public health needs in the region related to the Ebola virus outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: Africanews:ウガンダで新たなエボラワクチンの治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: 隣国DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関連し、ワクチン治験が開始されたとの報道で、IHR基準複数該当（重篤性・国際的拡大リスク）によりフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事本文はウガンダでのワクチン治験開始が主題だが、背景として隣国DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続中。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。治験そのものよりも背景のアウトブレイク状況の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Polio awareness campaign held at five Metro Rail stations in Chennai
article.articleSummary: Polio awareness campaign conducted as part of World Polio Day at five Chennai Metro Rail stations—Alandur, Airport, Vadapalani, Egmore, and Chennai Central. Rotary Club of Chennai Coastal and Rotary International District 3234 arranged banners and standees and distributed flyers to commuters. Rotary District Governor D. Suresh Jain attended with club presidents, secretaries, and district officers Dhanasekar, Palani, and T.S.P. Purushotham. The event took place on Saturday, 24 October 2026, and a press release described the effort as a public awareness initiative at busy transit hubs. The report emphasizes outreach to the commuting public; no polio case counts or laboratory data were mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイの地下鉄5駅でポリオ啓発キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 世界ポリオデーに関連する啓発活動の広報記事であり、症例数や感染拡大等の疫学的情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発イベントの広報に過ぎず、実際のポリオ症例や発生に関する情報がないため、対象国としての発生事実は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Mudanças climáticas já causam aumento de doenças infecciosas no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change is already causing an increase in infectious diseases in the country
article.articleSummary: Dengue transmission in Brazil is expanding as temperatures rise and rainfall patterns shift. A Fiocruz study found dengue-epidemic microregions increased from 110 (2006) to 292 (2024), now encompassing 54% of the country. In 2024, Rio Grande do Sul recorded about 210,000 dengue cases and 281 deaths; Bahia reported roughly 163,000 cases and 188 deaths. Oropouche fever, once concentrated in the Amazon, had over 12,000 cases in 2025 across 23 states and the Federal District. Floods in Rio Grande do Sul raised leptospirosis risk; droughts and wildfires bring wildlife nearer homes, aiding pathogen exposure. Hantavirus infections totaled 530 cases with 212 deaths since 2016 (≈40% fatality). Fungi are also affected: Candida auris—first reported in Bahia in 2020—has caused 24 occurrences in 15 states (all health facilities), 146 colonized, 56 deaths, with invasive cases up to 82% fatal. Aspergillus may spread to new areas as warmth and humidity rise.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がすでに国内の感染症増加を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: 複数の既知感染症（デング熱、オロプーシェ熱、レプトスピラ症、ハンタウイルス等）に関する気候変動由来の長期トレンドを総括した解説記事であり、新規の急性アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、即時のフルRRAよりも継続的な動向観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の気候変動と複数感染症（デング熱、オロプーシェ熱、レプトスピラ症、ハンタウイルス、カンジダ・オーリス等）の増加傾向を扱う総説的内容で、特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。数字は累積・年間統計であり、即時対応を要する緊急シグナルとは言い難いが、長期的な公衆衛生負荷の増大を示す点で継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria widens hunt for possible Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Nigeria widened Ebola contact tracing to 53 primary contacts, up from 44, after a 42-year-old Abuja woman—the wife of a Swiss embassy staff member—fell ill and remains the only confirmed case. A Rivers State suspected case tested negative. The nine additional contacts include health workers and the woman's family and household staff. WHO warns Africa faces a complex Ebola outbreak spanning west, east and central Africa. Nigeria, which stemmed a previous outbreak a decade ago, worries about spread from Oct 3 arrival to diagnosis, announced Tuesday. Screenings at international airports have been enhanced; Benin border forms are generic and lack Ebola checks, while Lagos-area sites have temperature screening and domestic flights remain unscreened. The DRC Bundibugyo outbreak has caused over 4,600 deaths; Uganda reports 20 cases, 2 deaths, Ebola-free; Kenya seven cases in isolation with two deaths this month.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ疑い例の捜索を拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はアフリカ西部・東部・中部にまたがる複合的アウトブレイクとなっており、DRCでは4,600人以上の死者が出ている重大な公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの疑い例調査拡大だが、ナイジェリア・ベナン・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのBundibugyoアウトブレイク（4,600人以上死亡）は記事中で実質的に言及されているため対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: W obliczu epidemii Eboli zarządzili obowiązkową kwarantannę na własny koszt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the face of the Ebola epidemic, they imposed mandatory quarantine at their own expense.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains deadly, with more than 4,600 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 17. The current epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda announced that its nationals returning from the DRC will undergo 21 days of home quarantine at their own expense, and intensified traveler screening will be conducted at Entebbe International Airport and across land borders. The measures follow Uganda’s August declaration by the WHO of Ebola-free status after 20 cases and 2 deaths, mostly among travelers from the DRC. Meanwhile, Kenya, where two deaths have occurred, and Nigeria reported first cases in October; Nigeria’s case involved a woman who arrived in Abuja by plane from Uganda. Ugandan officials dismissed the notion that the Nigeria case originated in Uganda, saying there are no active cases there.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に直面し、各国が自己負担での強制隔離措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4,600人以上の死者を出すエボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大と渡航制限措置が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例・死亡も報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる流行地はDRCであり、新規のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株でワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: México le Cierra el Mercado al Pollo de Brasil por Contingencia Sanitaria - Diario CAMBIO 22 - Península Libre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico Closes the Market to Brazilian Chicken Due to Health Contingency - Diario CAMBIO 22 - Península Libre
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-25, Mexico suspended imports of chicken meat, live birds, and fertile eggs from Brazil after authorities confirmed a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, southern Brazil. The Brazilian farm was closed and control/eradication actions were announced. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection affecting the respiratory and nervous systems in birds, reducing egg production and causing high mortality; there is no significant human health risk. The Mexican measure aims to shield its poultry sector, noting Mexico remains free of Newcastle disease. Brazil is a major global poultry exporter, shipping roughly 30% of its chicken production, with Mexico among its top destinations. The restriction adds to previous 2025 avian influenza-related suspensions by some markets, but this action centers on Newcastle disease and domestic safeguards pending Brazilian control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、衛生上の懸念によりブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場でのニューカッスル病発生に伴う貿易措置であり、記事中で明記されている通りヒトへの健康リスクは認められないため、人の感染症EBSとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり、記事内で『人への重大な健康リスクなし』と明記されている。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。貿易・農業分野の動向として監視対象にはなり得るが、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bengal sees late-season dengue surge, records 5.5k new cases in Oct
article.articleSummary: As of 25 Oct 2026, dengue surge in West Bengal with Kolkata recording over 5,500 new cases in the first 23 days of October. Through Oct 5, Kolkata had 2,800 cases; 1,270 in the final week of September. North Kolkata's Cossipore-Belgachhia accounts for ~25% of city cases. West Bengal crossed 5,000 in September, led by Murshidabad, with Howrah second and Kolkata third. Durga Puja week saw ~15% more Kolkata cases than typical weeks. Hospitals report rising activity: Charnock Hospital averages 8–10 dengue patients daily, with 10 admissions; some with platelet drops and hemorrhages. Manipal Hospital Dhakuria notes fever, joint pain, vomiting and rash; BP Poddar Hospital tested 80 samples (NS1/IgG/IgM) with 1 positive. Officials convened a meeting to discuss hotspots in Howrah, Murshidabad and other districts.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州で季節外れのデング熱急増、10月に新規5,500例を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドの季節性デング熱の流行拡大だが、IHR国際的拡大基準には該当せず、地域内公衆衛生対応として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節外れの増加とホットスポット地域での行政会議開催が報告されているが、重症度・死亡率の詳細情報は不明。地域流行として継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda refuerza controles fronterizos para frenar la propagación del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda strengthens border controls to curb the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens border controls to curb Ebola spread, requiring Congolese non-essential travelers to return via the nearest border crossing and to undergo a 21‑day quarantine at their own expense; those entering illegally face prosecution. The move follows investigations into how a woman who travelled from Uganda to Nigeria contracted Ebola. Congo’s outbreak has killed thousands, though Uganda reports no confirmed cases since declaring its outbreak over on July 28. Since May, Uganda has restricted non‑essential travel and intensified screening at Entebbe International Airport and land borders; arrivals—including diplomats and UN staff—must complete a passenger locator form and pass health checks. Swiss authorities say the Nigerian patient did not visit Congo; Ugandan authorities coordinate with Nigeria and international partners to review genomic findings and movements toward Abuja. In Kenya, a 40‑year‑old Kenyan man who lived in Congo tested positive on Oct 3 and died on Oct 5; eight contacts and a 65‑year‑old relative died (Kenya reports two deaths). Sixty contacts of the Kenyan patient completed 21 days of monitoring and were discharged. Bundibugyo Ebola virus is being addressed by Ugandan experts in the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱の拡大を抑えるため国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で数千人の死者を出しているエボラ出血熱の流行があり、ナイジェリア・ケニアへの越境感染例が報告され、ウガンダが国境管理を強化するなど国際的拡大と渡航制限の動きが見られるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、スイスも含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。DRCの流行が感染拡大の起点となっており、同国での状況を中心に評価した。他国（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ）への越境伝播や国境管理強化は国際的拡大・渡航制限の重要な根拠となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Orders 21-Day Ebola Quarantine for Returning Travelers
article.articleSummary: Uganda orders a 21-day Ebola quarantine for returning Ugandans with travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with quarantine fees and strengthened checks at Entebbe Airport and land crossings; arrivals must complete contact forms. Despite declaring no active infections after ending the Bundibugyo outbreak in July (20 infections, 2 deaths; outbreak over July 28), officials face renewed concerns as Ebola appears in Kenya and Nigeria. A Ugandan-born woman contracted Ebola during a September visit to Uganda, per Swiss authorities; Nigerian authorities confirmed her infection on Oct 20 after travel to Abuja, with movements under investigation. A Kenyan man who traveled from the DRC via Uganda to Nairobi on Oct 3 died two days later; Kenya reports a second Ebola death. In the DRC, by Oct 20 there were 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths; Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO on Oct 23 urged cross-border monitoring and cooperation, discouraging travel restrictions; no final source identified.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、帰国旅行者に21日間のエボラ検疫を命令
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が9,704症例・4,687死亡に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの関連症例にも言及しているが、これら3か国は評価対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。発生源であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola a băgat frica în autoritățile din SUA. Ce trebuie să facă românii care vor să călătorească în America
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic has frightened the authorities in the United States. What Romanians who want to travel to the United States should do.
article.articleSummary: New US public health measure amid Ebola outbreak: Starting November 3, 2026, all international flights to the United States must have passengers sign a declaration confirming they were not in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the preceding 21 days. The rule applies to travelers from Romania as well as those transiting Europe. Declarations can be electronic or paper; airlines must verify and refuse boarding if missing, unless exceptions approved by US authorities. Airlines must keep records for at least 42 days after arrival and provide them to authorities upon request. Violations may incur fines or imprisonment. The measure targets Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus, primarily in the DRC, with cases reported in Kenya and Nigeria; EU authorities rate overall risk as very low but urge continued surveillance and preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行で米国当局が緊張。アメリカへの渡航を希望するルーマニア人がすべきこと
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）がケニア・ナイジェリアにも拡大し、米国が国際便に対する渡航申告義務を導入するなど、国際的対応と渡航制限が実際に発生しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はルーマニア語メディアによる米国の渡航規制措置の報道。発生地域にUnited States, Romania, Kenya, Nigeriaが含まれるが、実際の感染発生国として記事が主題とするのはDRC（ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため除外）。EU当局は全体リスクを非常に低いと評価している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda orders 21-day Ebola quarantine for citizens returning from DR Congo - British Caribbean News
article.articleSummary: Uganda orders a 21-day quarantine for nationals returning from the DRC, self-funded, with enhanced checks at Entebbe Airport and land crossings and mandatory contact forms. Returned travelers with DRC exposure must quarantine; 60 people traced in Uganda completed 21 days of monitoring. Uganda says no active Ebola infections after ending its Bundibugyo outbreak in July (20 infections, 2 deaths). In the DRC, the Bundibugyo outbreak—originating in May and affecting eight provinces—has reached 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths as of October 20; no approved vaccine or specific treatment; incubation up to 21 days. Separately, a Ugandan-born woman contracted Ebola during a September visit in Uganda; Nigerian authorities confirmed infection on Oct 20 after travel to Abuja; WHO says she did not travel to DRC. A Kenyan man who traveled DRC→Uganda→Nairobi (Oct 3) died; both passed Entebbe the same day; no direct link established.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、DRCからの帰国者に21日間のエボラ検疫を命令 - ブリティッシュ・カリビアン・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが9,704症例・4,687死亡と極めて深刻化し、ナイジェリアやケニアへの越境感染例も報告されており、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のブンディブギョ型エボラアウトブレイク（致死率約48%）とそれに伴うウガンダの渡航制限措置が主題。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの越境感染例も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Le Nigeria élargit la traque des cas potentiels d'Ebola : Actualités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria broadens the search for potential Ebola cases: News
article.articleSummary: Nigeria intensified Ebola surveillance after nine more potential contacts were identified, bringing primary contacts to 53; a 42-year-old Swiss wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Abuja remains the sole confirmed case after returning from Uganda with her husband. A Rivers state suspect tested negative. The initial 44 contacts were health workers; the nine new contacts include other medical staff, the patient’s family, and domestic staff. WHO warned Africa faces a more complex Ebola outbreak across West, East and Central Africa. Nigeria, which previously contained an outbreak a decade ago, is racing to prevent spread between the Oct 3 arrival and the Tuesday diagnosis. Airport screening has been strengthened; at the Benin border health forms are generic with no Ebola checks, and Lagos reported temperature checks at a seaside resort; interior flights are not screened. The virus is Bundibugyo Ebola; no vaccine or specific treatment exists. DRC has thousands of deaths; Uganda reported cases but was declared Ebola-free; Kenya reported Ebola-related deaths and isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ出血熱の潜在的症例の追跡を拡大
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで確認されたエボラ出血熱患者を巡り接触者が53人に拡大し、国際的な拡大リスクとWHOによるアフリカ全体への懸念表明があり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準・社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる事例はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）だが、WHOが言及したDRCでの大規模な既存エボラ流行（数千人の死者）が対象国リストに含まれるため記載。ウガンダ・ケニアも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigerija plečia galimų Ebolos atvejų paiešką
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria expands search for potential Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria expands search for Ebola cases: 53 primary contacts identified (up from 44), linked to a 42-year-old Swiss embassy employee's wife in Abuja, the only confirmed case, who traveled with her husband through Uganda. Nine additional contacts are health workers; others are family or household staff. A suspected Rivers State case tested negative. WHO warns Africa faces a complex Ebola outbreak spanning West, East, and Central Africa. Nigeria tightened entry screening at international airports; land-border screening largely lacks temperature checks. Last week Nigeria reported West Africa's first case connected to a Congo DR outbreak—the imported Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda has 20 cases and two deaths related to Congo DR; it mandates 21-day isolation for returning travelers. Kenya reports two deaths this month; no official cases, but a Kenyan returning from Congo DR died; seven Ebola cases isolated in Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ出血熱の疑い症例の捜索を拡大
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで確認されたエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）症例がコンゴ民主共和国の流行に関連し、ウガンダ・ケニアにも拡大。WHOが複雑な流行を警告しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 主要発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（流行の起源）で、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・アンゴラ・モザンビークは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・特異的治療法のないBundibugyo株であり、ヒト-ヒト感染と医療従事者への感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Faecal contamination in Godavari, Krishna rivers surges 1,600%
article.articleSummary: August 2026 readings show faecal coliform levels: 160,000 MPN/100 ml in the Krishna at Suryapet and in the Godavari at Mulugu and Nizamabad, about 320 times the 500 MPN/100 ml benchmark. This follows June levels around 9,200 MPN/100 ml, marking a rise of over 1,600%. Telangana’s Godavari and Krishna are major water sources for Hyderabad, supplying more than 90% of the city’s drinking water; high FC concentrations raise risks of diarrhoea, typhoid, and parasitic infections, despite water treatment. Causes include untreated or inadequately treated sewage, leaking sewer lines, septic tanks, drains, industrial effluents, and wastewater from pharmaceutical/chemical industries. El Niño-driven below-normal rainfall reduces flows and dilution. Additional concerns appear at Musi at Valigonda (DO 1.28 mg/L; BOD 10.94 mg/L). Urban sewage infrastructure remains weak: Hyderabad has 42 STPs, 36 more planned, but only about 600 functional, with many discharging untreated wastewater into Musi.

triage.headline_ja: ゴーダヴァリ川・クリシュナ川の糞便汚染が1,600%増加
triage.triage_reason: テランガーナ州の主要河川で糞便性大腸菌群が基準値の320倍に急増し、チフスなど水系感染症のリスクが高まっているが、実際の患者発生報告はなく環境モニタリングデータの段階であるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は水質汚染データ（糞便性大腸菌群）に関する報道であり、チフス等の実際の患者発生数は報告されていない。インフラ不備（下水処理施設の稼働不足）が主因とされ、今後の患者発生動向を注視する必要がある。発生地域リストにはイタリアの地名が誤って含まれているが、記事内容はインドのテランガーナ州に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Garantizan insumos para el control de la malaria en seis municipios de Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They guarantee supplies for malaria control in six municipalities of Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 October 2026, Venezuela's State Health Directorate and the Malaria Elimination Program conducted a supply-and-distribution drive to support malaria control in six Amazonas municipalities: Autana, Alto Orinoco, Atabapo, Manapiare, Maroa, and Río Negro. The operation delivered antimalarial treatments, rapid diagnostic tests, and other essential inputs to healthcare posts in remote jungle areas, ensuring ongoing diagnostic and treatment capacity. In Mavaca parish and the Río Negro municipality, resources were allocated to bolster the national vaccination program through deployment of health personnel and vaccine stocks. These actions aim to secure timely medical care for populations in hard-to-reach zones of Amazonas. Separately, officials from the Ministry of Public Health and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) assessed malaria program training and supervision, highlighting advances in patient care and program implementation in Amazonas.

triage.headline_ja: アマソナス州6自治体のマラリア対策向け物資供給を保証
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ・アマソナス州でのマラリア対策物資配布という通常の保健活動の報告であり、対象国リストにも該当せず、異常性や社会的関心の高まりも認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域はベネズエラ（アマソナス州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。記事は定例的な保健当局の物資配布活動の報告。

article.articleHeadline: Melioidosis in India: a potentially deadly infection that may be going undetected
article.articleSummary: India-based multicentre study across 15 tertiary-care centres (Jan 2023–Dec 2025) found culture-confirmed melioidosis in 262 of 2,953 hospitalized adults (8.9%). Fifty deaths occurred in-hospital (19.1%). The Lancet Global Health study highlights diagnostic and surveillance gaps, suggesting true burden may be higher. Cases include a 48-year-old man with diabetes whose melioidosis was initially misidentified as Acinetobacter baumannii; he recovered after about three weeks of culture clearance. Additional reports describe a 25-year-old with sickle cell disease and type 1 diabetes with disseminated bone and lung involvement, and a 54-year-old man with diabetes and chronic liver disease presenting with pulmonary consolidation and bacteremia from Burkholderia pseudomallei. Melioidosis, found in soil and water of tropical/subtropical regions, transmits via skin wounds, inhalation, or ingestion; diabetes and other comorbidities increase risk. Diagnostic challenges include misidentification by automated systems; culture remains central; MALDI-TOF and PCR aid but limited by cost. Improved clinician–microbiologist communication and training are urged.

triage.headline_ja: インドのメリオイドーシス：見逃されている可能性のある致死的感染症
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はメリオイドーシス（既知の風土病）に関する多施設研究論文の紹介であり、急性の新規アウトブレイクや異常事象ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はLancet Global Health誌掲載の多施設研究結果の紹介であり、既知の風土病（土壌・水由来、非ヒト-ヒト感染）の診断・サーベイランスの課題を指摘する内容。新規アウトブレイクではなく、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina confirma segundo foco da doença de Newcastle em granja de perus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina confirms second outbreak of Newcastle disease at a turkey farm.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease: second outbreak confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Coronel Freitas, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, on the night of Oct 24, 2026, five days after the first outbreak in Nova Itaberaba. The virus was also detected in wild pigeons in Marema, indicating wild birds as a transmission source. The region remains under MAPA-declared zoosanitary emergency, which also covers Nova Erechim and Águas Frias. Surveillance has surveyed over 160 commercial poultry properties and 317 subsistence farms, with 78 samples collected for labs. Four sanitary barriers operate 24/7 to disinfect vehicles. Fifteen commercial farms in the area tested negative and were cleared for slaughter. Newcastle disease is a viral avian disease that can be fatal to birds; human infection may cause transient conjunctivitis, but it is not transmitted by consuming commercially inspected poultry meat.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州、七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病の第2発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（七面鳥）におけるニューカッスル病の発生であり、ヒトへの感染は軽度の結膜炎に限られ市販鶏肉からの感染もないため、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生当局（MAPA）が家禽産業保護のための監視・検疫措置を実施中だが、ヒト感染リスクは低く、EBS人獣共通感染症シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ouganda renforce les contrôles aux frontières pour lutter contre Ebola | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda strengthens border controls to fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens border controls to curb Ebola transmission from the DRC, imposing a 21-day home quarantine at return for Congolese travelers. Uganda, which declared its Ebola outbreak over July 28, has had no confirmed cases since. Measures at Entebbe and land borders require all arrivals to fill a locator form and undergo health screening; Congolese non-essential travelers are refused transit or entry, and illegal entrants face prosecution. Diplomats and UN staff are included in screening. Regarding the Nigerian case, authorities say investigators have not confirmed whether she visited the DRC; she has family in Uganda and the DRC and holds two passports. Genomic analyses and contact tracing are coordinated with Nigeria and international partners. Kenya reports two deaths; eight contacts tested positive; the Kenyan patient who transited via Uganda Oct 3–5 died Oct 5. Uganda deployed experts to stem the Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対策で国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）継続的発生に加え、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに越境・拡散が疑われる事例があり、国境封鎖等の渡航制限措置も取られているためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの国境管理強化が主題だが、感染源はDRCのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行であり、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例も報告されている。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。続報でDRC国内の感染状況や国際的対応の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Elecsys HCV Duo shows high agreement in multicenter hepatitis C evaluation
article.articleSummary: Multicenter evaluation of the Elecsys HCV Duo antibody–antigen immunoassay in China found 96.97% overall percent agreement with the two-assay workflow (Elecsys Anti-HCV II and ARCHITECT HCV Ag) across 923 serum samples from three Chinese hospitals. In seroconversion panels, the Duo antigen module reduced the mean interval from detectable HCV RNA to a positive result to 1.58 days, versus 28.67 days for antibody testing; RNA testing remains necessary to confirm active infection. Among 215 Anti-HCV-reactive samples with known RNA status, HCV Duo showed 100% agreement with Anti-HCV II in the RNA-positive subgroup (132 samples) and 98.8% in the RNA-negative subgroup (82/83). Antigen detection paralleled ARCHITECT HCV Ag (55.3% vs 56.8) and increased with higher RNA levels. Concurrent antibody and antigen positivity identified active infection in 34% of antibody-positive cases, supporting potential early screening/triage use but not replacement for molecular confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: Elecsys HCV Duo、多施設でのC型肝炎評価において高い一致率を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断薬（免疫測定法）の性能評価研究であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はHCV抗体・抗原検査キットの多施設臨床評価研究であり、疾患の発生や流行を報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda orders 21-day Ebola quarantine for citizens returning from DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda orders a 21-day Ebola quarantine for citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and tight screening at Entebbe International Airport and land borders; returning travelers pay quarantine costs, and Uganda reports no active infections within its borders. The DRC outbreak originated in May and is the largest to date, with 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths as of Oct 20 across eight provinces, caused by the Bundibugyo strain (no approved vaccine or specific treatment) and an incubation up to 21 days. A Kenyan man who traveled DRC→Uganda→Nairobi on Oct 3–5 died, with a second Kenyan death reported. A Ugandan-born woman infected during a September visit to Uganda was later confirmed in Nigeria on Oct 20 after traveling to Abuja; WHO says she did not necessarily travel to the DRC. Nigeria and Kenya–DRC cases underscore cross-border risk. WHO urges enhanced cross-border monitoring and advises against travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者に対しエボラ21日間検疫を命令
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（症例9,704、死者4,687）が発生し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染例も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの流行拡大と越境感染（ケニア、ナイジェリアでの死亡例）が主題であり、DRCを発生国として記載。WHOは渡航制限には反対の立場を表明している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: De Antequera al Congo para combatir las epidemias donde falta hasta el agua | Diario Sur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From Antequera to the Congo to fight epidemics where water is in short supply | Diario Sur
article.articleSummary: Spanish health workers from Área Sanitaria Norte de Málaga, with Médicos del Mundo, conducted a field mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo's South Kivu province, focusing on Miti-Muherca and Katana. They reinforce Ebola preparedness via fourteen triage centers, training staff to detect and isolate suspected cases, and implementing a ten-action triage protocol emphasizing PPE and infection control. The intervention also supports cholera response in Katana, providing twenty water chlorination points and emergency water supplies after Lugendo center lacked enough water to prepare oral rehydration salts. Upgrades include new storage tanks and rainwater collection to extend supply between communal water deliveries. The region continues a measles outbreak prompting a child vaccination campaign, with weekly incidence falling. Malaria remains a leading cause of fever in the area. The effort addresses multiple concurrent epidemics amid resource constraints.

triage.headline_ja: アンテケラからコンゴへ、水さえ不足する中で疫病と闘う｜Diario Sur
triage.triage_reason: DRC南キブ州における既存のエボラ・コレラ・麻疹流行への人道支援活動を報じる記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの速報ではないが、複数疾病の同時流行が継続しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はスペインの医療NGOによるDRC南キブ州（Miti-Muherca、Katana）での既存のエボラ対応トリアージ体制強化、コレラ対策（水の塩素化）、麻疹ワクチン接種活動を紹介する人道支援レポート。新規発生情報ではなく、既知の継続事案への対応。スペイン（Málaga/Andalusia）は医療従事者の派遣元であり発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC expands health declaration requirement for international travellers
article.articleSummary: Ebola case in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory confirmed on 20 October 2026, caused by Bundibugyo virus. A 42-year-old Ugandan woman who traveled from Uganda to Nigeria on 3 October developed symptoms on 6 October; this is an imported case from Uganda. Expanded health declaration requirements for international travellers were enacted, reversing earlier steps limited to travellers from DRC and Uganda; advisories were sent to FAAN and NCAA with planned airline coordination. Preparedness focuses on five international airports—Lagos, Abuja, Enugu, Kano and Port Harcourt—and Port Health Services coordinating with aviation personnel, immigration and customs to strengthen entry screening. Authorities have identified 53 primary contacts (44 at the health facility, 9 including household members and the FCT team) and are pursuing 21-day follow-ups. Measures include strengthening IPC in healthcare facilities, laboratory capacity, and public information to counter misinformation; cooperation with public health authorities is urged.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:ナイジェリア疾病予防管理センター(NCDC)が国際旅行者への健康申告義務を拡大
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの輸入エボラ症例がナイジェリアで確認され、53名の接触者追跡や国際空港での入国審査強化など、国際的拡大・渡航制限に関わる対応が取られているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本イベントの発生国はナイジェリア（輸入症例の由来はウガンダ）であり、いずれも指定対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。発生地域リストにDRCが含まれるが、記事本文ではDRCでの発生には言及がなく、以前の渡航制限対象国として言及されているのみのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 【Emily】港首濟公廟「再現」 驅瘟歷史重演 - 20261026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong's First Ji Gong Temple Reappears as History of Plague Exorcism Repeats Itself - 20261026
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong’s 2026 Ji Gong Cultural Carnival runs three days at Victoria Park, featuring the 'Ji Gong Exorcise Plague' sedan-chair demonstration combining competition with Ji Gong’s altruistic spirit. The event re-creates Wan Chai’s first Ji Gong temple scene in the vanished Di Long Li alley. It ties to the 1899 plague outbreak when bubonic plague hit Guangzhou and Hong Kong and spread to Hung Hom, with Wan Chai spared; locals believed Wan Chai’s temple protected them and sent a sedan-chair procession to Hung Hom to dispel the plague. The plaque 'We Fu Yan Wen' was cast by Hung Hom residents and later gifted to the Ji Gong temple. A procession happened yesterday; mid-next month at Sheung Wan’s Kwong Fuk Temple will host Ji Gong’s birthday rites and an exhibition on Hong Kong Ji Gong beliefs, with the plaque now at Kwong Fuk Temple.

triage.headline_ja: 【Emily】香港初の済公廟「再現」 疫病払いの歴史が繰り返される - 20261026
triage.triage_reason: 記事は1899年のペスト流行にまつわる文化的・宗教的祭事（済公廟の儀式）を扱ったものであり、現在の感染症発生を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的（1899年）ペスト流行に関連する文化祭・宗教儀式の紹介記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため対象国の発生なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina confirma segundo foco de doença de Newcastle em granja de perus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina confirms second outbreak of Newcastle disease in a turkey farm.
article.articleSummary: Second outbreak of Newcastle disease confirmed at a turkey-farming nucleus in Coronel Freitas (western Santa Catarina, Brazil), about 35 km from Nova Itaberaba, where the virus was first detected on Oct 19, 2026. Fifteen commercial farms in the region tested negative and were cleared to maintain normal production, including slaughter. Newcastle disease virus was also detected in free-range pigeons in Marema (SC), outside the emergency zone. Confirmation occurred between Oct 23–24, and more than 70% of the delineated surveillance area overlaps with the region monitored after the initial case identified Oct 18 in Nova Itaberaba, with most nearby properties already inspected. Defense teams continue surveillance and containment; producers are advised to keep protective screens on enclosures, control pests, and reinforce disinfection of vehicles, equipment, and footwear.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州、七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病の2件目の発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）疾患であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は報告されていない。対象国リストに含まれない国（ブラジル）での動物衛生事案であり、ヒト感染症シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類感染症でありヒトへの感染リスクは極めて低い。対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のうちBrazilが発生地域だが、本疾患はヒト向けEBSの対象外として扱うべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Health Minister Says Kenya Nears Ebola‑Free Declaration After 42‑Day Monitoring
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports Ebola cases imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the first patient detected on Oct 3. The 42-day period without new cases, per WHO, could see an Ebola-free declaration. 100% contact tracing has been achieved; 551 linked contacts were tested in the last 48 hours, all negative. The outbreak is confined to a single cluster of known contacts with no evidence of community transmission. Two deaths have occurred: a 45-year-old man linked to the imported case and a 65-year-old woman who died on Oct 23. About 21 more people are awaiting testing; those negative after the monitoring period may be released from quarantine. Public health measures include avoiding contact with blood or bodily fluids, regular handwashing, and seeking care if Ebola symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア保健相、42日間の監視後エボラ終息宣言に近づいていると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ輸入症例がケニアで発生し死者も出ており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例管理・終息宣言の見込みだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生源であるDRCでの進行中のエボラ流行が前提となっているため含めた。コミュニティ感染の証拠はなく、接触者追跡は100%完了と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Cisjordania, Sudán, ébola, inteligencia artificial... Las noticias del viernes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Bank, Sudan, Ebola, Artificial Intelligence... Friday's News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 9,765 confirmed cases and 4,727 deaths, expanding to an eighth province as of 23 October 2026. Nearly half of confirmed patients have died; about 30,000 contacts are under daily surveillance. The World Food Programme has delivered over 3,000 tonnes of food and served 744,000 hot meals at treatment and isolation centers, but $115 million is needed over six months to sustain food aid, air transport, and critical operations. West Bank: the UN rights office warns that Israel’s total closure of the occupied West Bank worsens Palestinian hardship, halting access to Hebron and the Ibrahim Mosque during Friday prayers and fueling displacement amid olive-harvest tensions and settler violence. Sudan’s El Fasher: aid groups report insecure conditions for displaced women, with 90% showing psychological distress and 80% of local hospitals nonfunctional; roughly 100,000 have fled to Chad over the past year due to ongoing fighting.

triage.headline_ja: 西岸地区、スーダン、エボラ出血熱、人工知能…金曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は9,765症例・4,727死亡（致死率約48%）で8州に拡大しており、深刻性・異常性・国際支援の必要性が明確で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行、西岸地区の人道危機、スーダン・エルファシールの紛争という3つの話題を並列的に扱う複合記事。トリアージ対象はDRCのエボラ流行。西岸地区とスーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria expands traveler health declarations over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) confirmed in Nigeria’s Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) on Oct 20, 2026. The patient is a 42-year-old Ugandan citizen who arrived in Nigeria on Oct 3 and developed symptoms on Oct 6. NCDC laboratory-confirmed the case, prompting expanded traveler health declarations for all international travelers after previous restrictions tied to DRC and Uganda were lifted. Preparedness targets five international airports—Lagos, Abuja, Enugu, Kano, Port Harcourt—with port health, aviation, immigration, and customs coordinating screening and entry controls; Lagos airport construction is complicating operations. A total of 53 primary contacts were identified (44 tied to the treating facility and 9 additional contacts including household members, others who assisted the patient at a second facility, and members of the FCT sample-collection team) and are monitored for 21 days, the Ebola incubation period.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ出血熱を受けて渡航者健康申告を拡大
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで輸入例によるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）が確認され、53名の接触者が特定されるなど、国際的拡大・渡航制限に関わる重大な公衆衛生事象であるため。
triage.notes: 発生国はナイジェリアであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRC・ウガンダは渡航制限の文脈で言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Reports No Symptoms Among 53 Ebola Contacts as Patient Improves | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease in Nigeria: A 42-year-old woman who traveled from Uganda via Addis Ababa reached Abuja, developed symptoms Oct 7, and was laboratory-confirmed Oct 20; she remains in isolation and is improving. By Oct 24, Nigeria’s NCDC reported no symptomatic or positive contacts among 53 people linked to the case. WHO had announced an imported Ebola Bundibugyo case on Oct 20, listing 44 contacts; Nigeria later counted 53. Genomic analysis reportedly linked the Nigerian virus to a strain detected in Kenya’s index case, though authorities say further investigation is needed to determine any epidemiological link. Contact tracing continues for 21 days from each person’s latest exposure, and infection-control measures are being strengthened. Nigeria is the fifth country to detect the current outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 15, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ接触者53人に症状なしと報告、患者は回復中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで宣言されたエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクがナイジェリアを含む5カ国に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入エボラ症例だが、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは本アウトブレイクの発生源として言及されており、対象国リストに該当するため含めた。ゲノム解析でケニアの症例株との関連が示唆されているが疫学的リンクは未確定。

article.articleHeadline: 泰男高雄入境抵台南 境外登革熱+1 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thai man who entered the country via Kaohsiung arrives in Tainan; Imported dengue fever case +1
article.articleSummary: Tainan City reports one additional imported dengue fever case: a Thai man in his 20s residing in Mingyi Village, Xuejia District. He developed fever on Oct 20, flew from Kaohsiung Airport on Oct 21, and tested NS1 positive at entry; later hospital admission confirmed by PCR. He is hospitalized during viremic phase and will be released after clearance. Health authorities have completed exposure and residence/workplace inspections and intensified vector control measures. Nationally, Taiwan tallies 216 dengue cases as of Oct 22: 14 locally acquired and 202 imported, with Vietnam the primary source, followed by Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia, and the Maldives. Public health officials urge continued mosquito precautions (light-colored long sleeves, approved repellents) and advise travelers returning from dengue-endemic regions to seek prompt medical care if fever develops and to report travel history.

triage.headline_ja: タイ人男性が高雄経由で入国後、台南でデング熱感染確認（輸入症例+1）
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入デング熱症例報告であり、対象国における発生事例ではなく、通常のサーベイランス報告の域を出ない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（対象国外）での輸入デング熱症例の定例報告。感染源としてベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピン等が言及されているが、これらの国で実際に発生・流行している事例ではなく、単に輸入元として記載されているのみのため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Novo foco de Newcastle amplia vigilância sobre aves em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New outbreak of Newcastle disease broadens surveillance of birds in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: New outbreak of Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina broadens surveillance. A second focus in poultry was confirmed Oct 23–24 in a turkey nucleus in Coronel Freitas, with sequencing confirming Newcastle virus. Over 70% of the surveillance zone overlaps the area of the first case, guiding mapping and inspections of surrounding properties. Fifteen farms tested negative, and a neighboring nucleus also showed no evidence of disease, enabling the Official Veterinary Service to authorize routine slaughter of healthy birds. The initial focus has entered a sanitary rest period after cleaning and disinfection, and first barrier has been demobilized. Pigeons living in Marema were found to harbor the virus, reinforcing the need for biosecurity. Measures include protective netting, pest control, vehicle and footwear disinfection, and preventing contact between wild and commercial birds. Coezoo completed the first surveillance round: over 160 farms inspected, 317 backyard properties checked, 78 samples collected, four barriers operating 24/7.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州で新たなニューカッスル病の発生、鳥類の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）における動物疾病の発生であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響は報告されておらず、対象国（ブラジル）の対象リストにも該当しないため見送り。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥・鳩）におけるニューカッスル病の動物衛生イベントであり、ヒト感染症ではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、動物疾患のみでヒトへの公衆衛生リスクが明示されていないため、トリアージ対象外としてDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉疫情　烏干達要求剛果返國公民隔離21天 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda requires Congolese returning citizens to quarantine for 21 days to curb the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda requires Congolese returning citizens to quarantine 21 days to curb Ebola outbreak in the DRC. As of 26 October 2026, travelers who transited Uganda were diagnosed abroad: one in Nigeria and one in Kenya. Nigeria reported a 42-year-old Swiss diplomat's wife diagnosed on 3 October after arriving in Abuja from Uganda via Addis Ababa; she remains in isolation with improving condition, 53 contacts traced. Kenya reported its first Ebola case the same day, linked to a traveler who passed through Entebbe airport from DRC to Nairobi; the patient died two days later. Uganda reviewed airport surveillance; the two confirmed cases appeared at Entebbe on the same day with no direct contact. Sixty Ugandan contacts linked to the Kenyan case completed 21-day monitoring. Uganda tightened screening at airports and land borders; entrants must fill tracking forms. WHO Director-General Tedros condemned violence against frontline workers in Bafwasende, northern DRC, urging protection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫病の拡大防止のため、ウガンダがコンゴ帰国市民に21日間の隔離を義務付け
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱がウガンダ経由でナイジェリア・ケニアへ国際的に拡大し、ケニアでは死亡例も発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当、社会的関心の高まりが確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラ出血熱の国際的拡散（ウガンダ経由でナイジェリア・ケニアへ）。ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。WHO事務局長がDRC北部バフワセンデでの前線スタッフへの暴力を非難している点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda imposes 21-day quarantine on citizens returning from Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine on Ugandan citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo as Ebola precautions tighten. Although Uganda declared Ebola-free in July, concerns persist after two travelers who passed through Uganda tested positive in Kenya and Nigeria. In Nigeria, a 42-year-old woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat, who had returned from Uganda via Addis Ababa to Abuja on Oct 3, is isolated with 53 contacts traced; genomic sequencing ties her Nigerian case to the Kenyan strain, though Nigeria cites no evidence the Kenya patient travelled to Nigeria. The Kenyan patient travelled from Congo to Uganda, then Entebbe to Nairobi on Oct 3 and died two days later; both cases passed through Entebbe that day, with CCTV showing no direct contact. Uganda reports 60 Kenyan contacts completed 21-day monitoring; traveler screening at Entebbe and land borders intensified, and passenger locator forms are required.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者に対し21日間の検疫を義務化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国を起点にウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大し、死亡例・隔離措置・接触者追跡が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの感染者発生とウガンダの検疫措置だが、これら3カ国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染経路の起点であるコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のみを対象国として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: MISE EN ŒUVRE D'UN ESSAI CLINIQUE CONTRE EBOLA EN RDC : Une lueur d'espoir - Editions Le Pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Implementation of a Clinical Trial Against Ebola in the DRC: A Glimmer of Hope - Editions Le Pays
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the 17th Ebola outbreak involves Bundibugyo virus (a Zaïre ebolavirus lineage) with more than 9,500 infections and at least 4,600 deaths, affecting seven provinces and posing spillover risk to Kenya and Nigeria. The first Tumaini clinical trial participant was vaccinated on 23 October in Bunia, Ituri Province, marking progress toward evaluating safety and immunogenicity of candidate vaccines. The study is led by the National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB) and the University of Antwerp, with World Health Organization support. Although Ervebo exists, its efficacy against Bundibugyo is unestablished, underscoring the potential importance of the RDC trial. Additional candidates from Moderna and from the University of Oxford in collaboration with the Serum Institute of India are anticipated. The article stresses vigilance, surveillance of contacts, and continued international support to curb transmission and address population hesitancy, noting a fatality rate around 48.2%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱に対する臨床試験の実施：希望の光
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行は感染者9,500人超、死者4,600人超、致死率約48.2%と極めて深刻で、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの波及リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sífilis adquirida crescem 343% em cinco anos em Uberaba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acquired syphilis cases rise 343% in five years in Uberaba
article.articleSummary: Acquired syphilis cases in Uberaba, Minas Gerais, Brazil rose 343% from 157 in 2020 to 695 in 2025, per SES-MG. In 2026, by August 5, 320 cases were notified. Annual counts show continuous growth: 309 (2021), 348 (2022), 423 (2023), 571 (2024), 695 (2025). By sex/age, the burden concentrates among men 20–39 (e.g., 20–29: 78 men, 45 women; 30–39: 50 men, 24 women); adolescents 10–19: 24 women, 8 men. Syphilis is sexually transmitted by Treponema pallidum; acquired syphilis is curable, with diagnosis and treatment free via SUS. Prevention includes condom use, post-exposure testing, and partner assessment. Uberaba ranked 7th in Minas Gerais for 2026 notifications (by Aug 5), Belo Horizonte leading with 3,063 cases; 2026 data are partial, so cross-year comparisons should be cautious.

triage.headline_ja: ウベラバ市での後天性梅毒症例、5年間で343%増加
triage.triage_reason: 慢性的な性感染症の長期的増加傾向を報じる地方statisticsであり、急性の公衆衛生危機や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 梅毒は治療可能な性感染症であり、SUS（公的医療制度）で無料診断・治療が提供されている。地域統計の経年変化を報じる記事で、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda refuerza controles fronterizos para frenar la propagación del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda strengthens border controls to curb the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo drive Uganda to tighten border controls, imposing a 21-day quarantine at travellers’ own expense for those returning from the DRC. Uganda has deployed Ebola experts to the Congo to assist containment. The Ugandan Ministry notes no confirmed Ebola cases since declaring its outbreak over on July 28 and had previously restricted transit since May, excluding essential personnel and enforcing border checks, including prohibitions on transit for travelers with Congo travel history and limiting chartered flights. The measures accompany a Kenya-linked case: a Kenyan man, 40, who lived in the Congo, traveled through Uganda to Kenya on October 3; he tested positive and died on October 5. Sixty contacts were monitored for 21 days and discharged; eight contacts later tested positive; a 65-year-old relative died on Friday, raising Kenya’s Ebola deaths to two.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ拡大阻止のため国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がケニアへ越境し複数死亡例が発生、ウガンダも国境検疫を強化しており国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが明確なため。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda imposes 21-day quarantine on citizens returning from Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine on citizens returning from Congo as it probes Ebola-linked cases connected to the Congo outbreak. Nigerian authorities confirm one Ebola case—the wife of a Swiss diplomat who visited Uganda last month—while Ugandan officials review genomic data and travel histories with Nigeria and international partners. Swiss authorities say she contracted the virus in Uganda; Uganda's minister questions that conclusion, noting West Nile relatives who visited Kansanga had themselves visited Congo. Kenya's first Ebola patient travelled from Congo to Uganda, then Entebbe to Nairobi on Oct 3 and died Oct 5. Both cases passed through Entebbe on the same day, with CCTV suggesting no direct contact; 60 contacts of the Kenyan case completed 21-day monitoring. Uganda tightens airport and land-border screening; all travelers must submit a passenger locator form. Nigerian sequences link the Nigerian strain to Kenya's; no evidence of direct Kenya-Nigeria travel.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ(DRC)発のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへ越境拡大し、死亡例・渡航制限措置が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ(DRC)由来のエボラアウトブレイクに関連した越境症例（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイス人外交官夫人）であるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Nhận diện các loại cúm mùa thường gặp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Identifying the common types of seasonal influenza.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza is caused by Orthomyxoviridae, four types: A, B, C, and D. Types A and B drive seasonal illness; C is milder; D mainly infects cattle and is not confirmed as a human pathogen. Type A is genetically variable and subdivided by surface proteins hemagglutinin (H) and neuraminidase (N); subtypes such as A(H1N1) and A(H3N2) circulate and can cause epidemics. Type B also causes seasonal disease and can lead to serious complications, especially in children and at-risk individuals. Type C infections are infrequent and resemble a cold; Type D infections are not established. Symptoms include abrupt fever, chills, headache, myalgia, fatigue, cough, sore throat, and nasal symptoms; vomiting/diarrhea may occur in children. Seek care for persistent high fever, breathing difficulty, chest pain, or dehydration. Vaccination, hand hygiene, and early antivirals for high-risk patients are advised. In Vietnam, influenza activity fluctuates; on Oct 1, cases rose, with no abnormal surge.

triage.headline_ja: よくある季節性インフルエンザの種類を見分ける
triage.triage_reason: 一般的なインフルエンザの解説記事であり、ベトナムでの異常な流行拡大は報告されていない（「異常な急増はない」と明記）。
