article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle tem novo foco em Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease has a new outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in western Santa Catarina, Brazil, with a focus in Coronel Freitas affecting a turkey flock. Lab confirmation on 23–24 October by sequencing. Surveillance covers areas, with over 70% overlap with prior monitoring; 15 farms tested negative, allowing healthy birds to be slaughtered and maintaining production in disease-free zones. The initial focus was identified on 18 October; after cleaning and disinfection, a sanitation hiatus began and the first sanitary barrier was removed, while monitoring continues. Pigeons in Marema tested positive for Newcastle virus and are the source of the Coronel Freitas outbreak. Biosecurity urges preventing contact between wild and domestic birds, keeping aviary screens, pest control, and disinfection of vehicles and footwear. As of 24 October, Coezoo reports over 160 poultry farms inspected, 317 subsistence properties checked, 78 samples collected, and four barriers in operation 24/7; efforts persist until eradicating the outbreak and protecting Santa Catarina’s aviculture.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病、サンタカタリーナ州で新たな発生
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）の疾病であり人獣共通感染症としての人への直接影響は報告されていないが、貿易・畜産業への影響があり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病で人への感染リスクは極めて低い。本事例はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州での七面鳥・鳩における発生で、当局により防疫措置（監視区域設定、検査、処分、消毒）が実施されている。人の公衆衛生への直接的な影響は報告されていないため、動物衛生当局（WOAH等）の管轄範囲の事案である。

article.articleHeadline: [비전21뉴스] 화성특례시, 결핵환자·잠복결핵감염 치료자에 영양보충제 지원
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hwaseong Special City to provide nutritional supplements to tuberculosis patients and to those undergoing treatment for latent tuberculosis infection.
article.articleSummary: Hwaseong Special City's four district health centers (Manse, Hyohaeng, Byeongjeom, Dongtan) will begin distributing health kits with nutritional supplements to registered tuberculosis patients and latent TB infection treatment patients from November 2, 2026. Each center’s TB nurse will provide counseling; recipients may receive a one-time kit during treatment containing vitamin B complex, vitamin C, and probiotics. The program aims to support adherence and completion of treatment and will continue in 2027. TB requires long-term anti-TB therapy, which can cause appetite loss and gastrointestinal symptoms; LTBI preventive therapy likewise requires ongoing medication and monitoring. Centers will instruct on supplement use, monitor TB medication intake and adverse effects (indigestion, loss of appetite, rash), and coordinate care through completion. Dongtan Public Health Center Director Yu Jong-woo emphasized ongoing treatment and reminded that cough lasting two weeks or more should prompt screening at the nearest clinic.

triage.headline_ja: [ビジョン21ニュース] 華城特例市、結核患者・潜在性結核感染治療者に栄養補助剤を支援
triage.triage_reason: 韓国・華城市における既存結核患者への栄養補助プログラムの行政広報であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国（対象国外）の地方自治体による結核患者支援プログラムの紹介記事。中国（Gansu等）は発生地域に含まれるが記事内容とは無関係で誤タグと判断、対象国リストにも該当国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz aponta avanço de doenças infecciosas em 54% do território brasileiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz points to the spread of infectious diseases in 54% of Brazilian territory.
article.articleSummary: Dengue endemic microrregiões in Brazil rose from 110 to 292 between 2006–2024, now spanning 54% of the country; Rio Grande do Sul recorded 210,000 infections and 281 deaths in 2024. Fiocruz links this expansion to climate anomalies that alter the Aedes aegypti life cycle: dormant eggs hatch when humidity and temperature rise, and high temperatures boost biting. Extreme events amplify pathogen spillover: floods raise leptospirosis and other waterborne infections; droughts and fires push small mammals toward urban areas, increasing hantavirus risk (40% case fatality; 212 deaths in 530 cases since 2016). Oropouche fever moved from the Amazon to 23 states and the Federal District, with more than 12,000 cases by 2024. Fungal pathogens are adapting to heat; Candida auris has caused deaths in health facilities since 2020, with up to 82% mortality in bloodstream infections, and Trichophyton indotineae shows antifungal resistance. Disease ranges are expanding toward endemic transmission amid ecological change.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルスがブラジル国土の54%で感染症の拡大を指摘
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・オロプーシュ熱・レプトスピラ症・ハンタウイルスなど複数の感染症がブラジル国内で地理的に急拡大しており、重症例・死亡例も多数報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: Fiocruz（ブラジル公衆衛生研究機関）による複数疾患の気候変動関連拡大に関する総説的報告。デング熱の流行地域は2006-2024年で110から292ミクロリージョンに拡大（国土の54%）、リオグランデドスル州で21万人感染・281人死亡。ハンタウイルス致死率40%、オロプーシュ熱はアマゾン地域から23州へ拡大。カンジダ・アウリスなど薬剤耐性真菌感染症も言及されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限についての言及はなく、主にブラジル国内の構造的・気候関連の疾病動態変化を扱った分析記事。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda mandates health screening for all entrants, including diplomats, amid DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda orders mandatory health screening for all entrants, including diplomats and UN staff, amid ongoing Ebola transmission in neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). As of 25 October 2026, travellers arriving by air, land, or sea must complete a Passenger Locator Form and undergo Port Health screening, with no exemptions for foreign officials. Border checks are being intensified at Entebbe International Airport and all land crossings, including sanitisation of baggage trays and passports. People who have recently travelled to the DRC face strict movement restrictions, possible inclusion on a no-fly list, and mandatory 21-day quarantine for returning Ugandans, at the individual's expense. Evading screening or obstructing health teams could trigger self-funded quarantine and prosecution under the Public Health Act. Restrictions target essential travellers such as truck drivers and humanitarian workers; non-essential Congolese nationals attempting crossing will be turned back at their own cost.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、DRCでのエボラ流行を受け、外交官を含む全入国者に健康スクリーニングを義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ流行に対し隣国ウガンダが厳格な国境管理・検疫措置を導入しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生中のエボラ流行に対するウガンダの越境対策であり、感染発生国はDRC。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 源途有你｜鼠疫宿主尚未绝迹　香港如何严防输入？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Origin Path with You | Plague reservoir hosts have not yet gone extinct — How does Hong Kong guard against imported plague cases?
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague caused by Yersinia pestis poses imported risk to Hong Kong after a laboratory incident in Irkutsk, Russia, where a female technician broke a live sample and died of severe pneumonia. Pneumonic plague spreads by droplets and can kill within hours if untreated; incubation about 24 hours and mortality approaches 100%. Globally, droplet transmission fuels rapid clusters; historic context includes 1910 Wu Lien-teh work in Northeast China that demonstrated human-to-human spread. Natural reservoirs persist in Eurasian grasslands and forests, so sporadic foci remain even with modern controls. The World Health Organization 2021 plague-control report notes persistent wild rodent reservoirs and occasional cases in remote areas. Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection has ramped up surveillance and containment readiness to guard against imported cases; authorities emphasize vigilance and public hygiene, not panic, leveraging lessons from past outbreaks and available isolation facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 源途有你｜ペスト宿主はまだ絶滅していない　香港はどう輸入ペストを防ぐか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの実験室事故による単発の肺ペスト死亡例に関する解説記事であり、対象国での実際の発生は確認されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 事案の発生地はロシア・イルクーツクの実験室内であり、対象国リストに含まれない。香港（中国）は輸入リスクへの備えとして言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Attackers kill nurse, severely injure health worker responding to Ebola case in eastern Congo - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: Attack in Bafwasende, eastern Congo's Tshopo province: a nurse was killed and a health worker severely injured while responding to an Ebola alert. The incident adds to a string of assaults on responders hindering efforts to slow the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the world. As of October 25, 2026, Congo's health ministry reports more than 9,800 Ebola cases and over 4,700 deaths since the outbreak began in May, the deadliest in the country's history. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus condemned the attack and called for safe, dignified work for frontline staff; WHO Africa regional director Dr. Mohamed Yakub Janabi likewise condemned the violence amid misinformation and distrust. Local authorities have not commented. Earlier in May, two tents at health centers were burned in separate attacks; responders report harassment and captivity in some zones, and distrust complicates outreach.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ対応中の看護師が殺害され、保健従事者が重傷を負う-WTOPニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪・世界最速拡大のエボラ流行が進行中（感染者9,800人超、死者4,700人超）であり、対応妨害も深刻化しておりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長およびアフリカ地域事務局長が攻撃を非難しており、対応要員への暴力が流行対策の大きな障害となっている。既に世界最速拡大・史上最悪規模のアウトブレイクとされ、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Attackers kill nurse, severely injure health worker responding to Ebola case in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Two health workers responding to an Ebola alert in Butembo’s Bafwasende area, Tshopo province, Congo, were targeted: a nurse was killed and a health worker severely injured. The incident highlights ongoing violence against responders amid Congo’s Ebola outbreak, described by WHO as the fastest-growing and deadliest in the country’s history. As of 26 Oct 2026, Congolese health ministry data indicate more than 9,800 cases and over 4,700 deaths since the outbreak began in May. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Africa regional director Dr. Mohamed Yakub Janabi condemned the attack and called for protection of frontline staff, stressing that misinformation and fear fuel violence. Community distrust and resistance to response measures persist, complicating efforts despite a village-centered approach; earlier in May, tents at health centers were set alight, and responders have faced threats and detention in some zones. Local authorities have not identified suspects.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ対応中の看護師が襲撃され死亡、医療従事者も重傷
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで史上最速・最悪規模とされるエボラ流行が継続中（9,800例超・死者4,700人超）であり、対応要員への暴力も発生しており公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が声明を出すなど国際的注目度が高く、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続・悪化を示す重要な続報。フルリスク評価に進むべき案件。

article.articleHeadline: Không chủ quan với bệnh cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't take Influenza A lightly.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A occurs year-round with seasonal peaks. In Vietnam, the National Institute of Infectious Diseases (Ministry of Health) has admitted several Influenza A cases with severe pneumonia, requiring 40–50% supplemental oxygen and non-invasive ventilation. After three days of treatment, fever resolved and hemodynamics stabilized, but lung injury remained, necessitating ongoing respiratory support. In COPD patients, airway inflammation and mucus can worsen airflow obstruction, increasing risk of respiratory failure; fever level alone does not gauge severity. Authorities urge annual influenza vaccination for high-risk groups (elderly; children under five; pregnant women; postpartum within two weeks; chronic disease or immunodeficiency) and advocate hygiene measures: masks in public settings, hand washing, cough etiquette, ventilation, and limiting contact with symptomatic individuals. Do not use antivirals or antibiotics without medical guidance. Seek urgent care for signs such as shortness of breath, rapid breathing, cyanosis, chest pain, confusion, or deterioration, especially in children.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAを軽視してはいけない
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAに関する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、異常な流行や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザに関する公衆衛生啓発記事。重症例の報告はあるが、異常発生やアウトブレイクを示す記述はなく、通常の季節性疾患として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تبدأ اختبار لقاح جديد لمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo begins a new Ebola vaccine trial.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) has begun a new Ebola vaccine trial. The study will assess safety and efficacy, define targeted groups, and monitor adverse effects across trial phases. Health officials stress that launching a trial does not equate to vaccine approval for general use or final efficacy confirmation; decisions will hinge on study results and data analysis. In parallel, authorities continue surveillance for Ebola exposure, isolating confirmed cases when identified, tracing contacts, and conducting public health education. Frontline workers are being equipped with necessary protective gear to reduce transmission and support outbreak response. No case counts or outbreak status are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、新たなエボラワクチンの試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 新規エボラワクチン臨床試験の開始を報じるもので、現時点での症例数・アウトブレイク状況の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン試験開始に関する内容で、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの規模は報告されていない。サーベイランス継続中との記載はあるが詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: Attackers kill nurse, severely injure health worker responding to Ebola case in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Attackers killed a nurse and severely injured a health worker in Bafwasende, Tshopo province, Congo, while responding to an Ebola alert. The attack underscores violence against responders complicating the response to what authorities describe as the fastest-growing and deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo's history. Since May, the outbreak has produced more than 9,800 cases and over 4,700 deaths, according to Congo's health ministry. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi condemned the assault and called for safe, dignified operations for health workers. Authorities have not commented on suspects. Misinformation and fear are cited as fueling violence. Response efforts have faced community skepticism and resistance, with a village-centered approach faced with distrust, past attacks (two tents burned in May), and threats against responders and safe burials. The outbreak's ongoing spread is hampering containment in remote areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ対応中の医療従事者が襲撃され、看護師が死亡、別の医療従事者が重傷
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大・最速拡大とされるエボラ流行（9,800例超、死者4,700人超）が継続し、対応要員への暴力により封じ込めが阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接声明を発表するなど国際的注目度が高く、既存の大規模流行事例としてフルリスク評価が妥当。地理情報はBafwasende/Tshopo州（DRC国内）であり、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Attackers kill nurse responding to Ebola case in Congo
article.articleSummary: An Ebola alert in Congo’s eastern Tshopo province town of Bafwasende was followed by an attack that killed a nurse and severely injured another health worker, highlighting violence against responders amid the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. As of 26 October 2026, Congo’s health ministry reports more than 9,800 cases and over 4,700 deaths since the outbreak began in May, making it the deadliest in the country’s history. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus condemned the attack and urged protection of healthcare workers; regional director Dr. Mohamed Yakub Janabi cited misinformation and fear fueling violence. Community resistance and distrust, including in North Kivu where a politician was killed earlier, have hampered response despite a village-centered strategy. Cross-border concerns include Uganda quarantining returning citizens with Congo travel history for 21 days, while linked cases have appeared in Kenya and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ対応中の看護師が襲撃により死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模（9,800例以上、死亡4,700人超）のエボラ流行が拡大しており、医療従事者への暴力や周辺国（ウガンダの検疫、ケニア・ナイジェリアでの関連症例）への越境拡大がみられるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの関連症例・検疫措置が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。DRCが主要な発生国である。

article.articleHeadline: 현대바이오, 美 감염병 학회서 '제프티' 임상 공개···범용 항바이러스제 개발 추진
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hyundai Bio unveils clinical data on 'Jepti' at an American infectious disease conference, pursuing development of a broad-spectrum antiviral.
article.articleSummary: Hyundai BioScience reported early clinical data on Jepti (CP-COV03), a broad-spectrum oral antiviral, at IDWeek 2026 in Washington, DC, detailing the DEN-201 Phase 2/3 program for dengue and related febrile infections. Led by UC San Diego Professor David Smith, the study is conducted in Vietnam, with approvals from the Ministry of Health, at Hanoi National Tropical Diseases Hospital and Tien Giang General Hospital. In an initial blinded safety analysis, no serious adverse events or deaths were observed; drug-related adverse events were mild-to-moderate GI symptoms. Because the analysis did not separate treatment from placebo, it does not establish Jepti’s safety or efficacy. Hyundai will use Phase 2 dose-ranging data to finalize doses for ongoing trials and intends a Phase 3 basket design expanding to dengue, Zika, influenza, and COVID-19, then broaden to children and the elderly if adult results are favorable.

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオ、米感染症学会で『ジェプティ』臨床データ公開…広域抗ウイルス剤開発推進
triage.triage_reason: 感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、製薬企業による治験薬の臨床データ発表に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱等の治療薬候補の治験実施報告であり、ベトナムでの感染症流行自体を報じたものではないため、発生国としてのベトナムは該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina confirma novo foco da doença de Newcastle em granja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina confirms new outbreak of Newcastle disease on a farm.
article.articleSummary: Second outbreak of Newcastle disease confirmed in Santa Catarina, Brazil, at a commercial turkey farm in Coronel Freitas, in the western region, on Oct 24, 2026, following a first outbreak in Nova Itaberaba. The virus was also detected in wild pigeons in Marema, elevating concerns about transmission to other farms. Cidasc, the state agricultural agency, intensified surveillance; four municipalities—Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, Águas Frias, Nova Erechim—are under a 60-day federal zoonotic/animal health emergency, enabling expanded controls such as farm inspections, sample collection, and sanitary barriers. In Nova Itaberaba, 6,526 turkeys were culled to curb spread; the farm underwent cleaning and disinfection. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection in birds, causing respiratory and neurological symptoms with high mortality; human infections are rare, typically conjunctivitis after direct contact with infected birds. Authorities continue monitoring western Santa Catarina to prevent further spread and protect aviculture.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州、養鶏場でニューカッスル病の新たな発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州で同地域内2例目のニューカッスル病発生があり、野鳥への感染拡大や連邦非常事態宣言など政府の強い関与が見られるため、家禽産業・貿易への影響評価を含むフルリスク評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: ヒトへの感染は結膜炎など軽症例に限られ、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は低いが、家禽産業・貿易（ブラジルは主要家禽輸出国）への波及や野生鳥類を介した拡散リスクがあるため動物衛生・貿易影響の観点から継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: સ્થાનિકો કચરાના ઢગલા વચ્ચે રહેવા મજબૂર, રોગચાળાનો ડર: મુંજકા શહેરમાં ભળ્યું પણ સુવિધા ઝીરો રોજ સફાઈ ન થતાં ગંદકીના ગંજ ખડકાયા
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Locals forced to live amid heaps of garbage, fear of an outbreak: in Munjka city it has taken hold, but facilities are zero and daily cleaning is not done, garbage piles up.
article.articleSummary: Munjka village, now within Rajkot city limits after expansion, suffers persistent filth with Street No. 7 lacking regular cleaning and no proper waste disposal. Public dumps grow into large garbage piles, emitting an unacceptable odor, as residents and nearby areas discard waste in open spaces. The ensuing mosquito nuisance raises fears of dengue and malaria outbreaks, posing health risks to children and the elderly. Despite multiple representations, local authorities have not acted, and residents demand immediate daily cleaning in Street No. 7. This situation underscores potential infectious disease risk (dengue, malaria) tied to poor sanitation and stagnant waste, with no reported case counts in the article but clear outbreak fears and urgent public health concerns.

triage.headline_ja: 住民、ゴミの山の中での生活を強いられる 感染症流行への懸念：ムンジカ市は拡大したが施設整備はゼロ、毎日の清掃が行われずゴミの山が積み上がる
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症症例報告はなく、ゴミ放置による蚊の発生とデング熱・マラリア流行への「懸念」を報じる地域生活問題記事であり、公衆衛生上の実質的イベントとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数や発症報告を含まず、衛生環境悪化に対する住民の苦情と将来的な流行への懸念を伝えるローカルニュース。感染症の実発生を示す情報はないためDISMISSとしたが、地域の衛生状態悪化は蚊媒介感染症のリスク要因として留意すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 医生称幼儿需警惕呼吸道合胞病毒 流行季提前
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn that young children should be vigilant for respiratory syncytial virus as RSV season starts earlier.
article.articleSummary: RSV (respiratory syncytial virus) season starts earlier this year in China. China CDC monitoring shows most regions remain low for respiratory infections, with an upward trend, and RSV cases emerging sooner, especially in humid southern areas. RSV is highly contagious, spreading by droplets and contact, and is a leading cause of pneumonia and bronchiolitis in children under 5, with greater risk for those under 2, particularly preterm infants or with congenital heart disease. Infection may affect the airways, causing edema, increased secretions, and wheeze, and severe cases may lead to respiratory failure. Recurrent or severe infections may raise later asthma risk; antibodies provide short protection, and reinfection is possible within the season. For infants with persistent cough or nocturnal wheeze, seek hospital care; signs of hypoxia (lips turning purple) require urgent treatment. Do not misuse antibiotics; they are ineffective against RSV, and avoid self-administered cough syrups or nebulization unless prescribed.

triage.headline_ja: 医師、幼児はRSV（呼吸器合胞体ウイルス）に警戒を—流行シーズンが例年より早まる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVに関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: RSVは既知の季節性ウイルスであり、中国国内での流行時期がやや早まったという通常の医療情報記事。CDC監視データも低〜上昇傾向であり、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda imposes 21-day quarantine on citizens returning from DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine on Ugandan citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo as it tightens Ebola precautions after declaring Ebola-free in July. Two travelers who passed through Uganda later tested positive abroad (Kenya, Nigeria). Nigeria reports 42-year-old wife of Swiss diplomat, who returned from Uganda via Addis Ababa to Abuja on Oct 3; 53 contacts have been traced, and she remains in isolation with improving condition. Uganda reviews genomic data and travel movements with Nigerian authorities. Kenya’s first Ebola patient travelled from DR Congo to Uganda, Entebbe to Nairobi on Oct 3 and died two days later. CCTV shows no interaction at Entebbe; 60 contacts linked to the Kenyan case completed 21-day monitoring. Screening at Entebbe and borders has been intensified, and passenger locator forms are required. WHO reports a nurse killed and a health worker injured responding to an Ebola alert in Bafwasende, DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者に21日間の検疫を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱がウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへ国境を越えて拡散し、死亡例も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: DRCのBafwasendeで発生したエボラ発生源からウガンダ経由でケニア（死亡例あり）・ナイジェリア（スイス外交官の妻の感染例）へ越境拡大。ウガンダは7月にエボラ終息宣言後、帰国者への21日間検疫や国境スクリーニング強化を実施。WHOも医療従事者の被害を報告しており、国際的な注目・対応が必要な状況。対象国としてはDRCのみがリストに該当（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达收紧伊波拉防疫措施 曾赴刚果旅客入境须隔离21天
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Tightens Ebola Prevention Measures; Travelers Who Have Been to the Congo Must Quarantine for 21 Days Upon Entry.
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens Ebola prevention measures as cross-border transmission concerns rise. Travelers who have been to the Democratic Republic of the Congo must quarantine for 21 days on entry, with strengthened airport and border screening to curb cross-border spread. Uganda, which declared the latest Ebola outbreak over in July 2026, faces renewed risk as Kenya and Nigeria recently confirmed cases; both patients had passed through Uganda, triggering heightened vigilance. Uganda is investigating Nigeria’s confirmed case: a 42-year-old woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat, who visited Uganda last month. Kenya’s first Ebola patient died two days after flying from Entebbe, Uganda, to Nairobi on October 3, after travelling from the Congo via Uganda on a chartered flight. The situation underscores ongoing regional transmission risk and the need for enhanced surveillance and strict entry controls.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対策を強化 コンゴ渡航者に21日間の入国隔離を義務化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国を起点に越境拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリアで確認例（死亡例含む）が発生、ウガンダが入国隔離措置を強化しておりIHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 主な感染拡大・越境移動の起点はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただしDRCからの越境感染が記事の中心的主題であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تبدأ اختبار لقاح جديد لمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo begins testing of a new vaccine to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo begins Ebola vaccine trials in Kinshasa, evaluating safety, efficacy, and targeted groups while monitoring adverse events across clinical stages. The effort aims to curb Ebola transmission and enhance outbreak response, but officials caution that initiating trials does not imply vaccine approval for general use or proven effectiveness; conclusions depend on trial data. Findings will guide decisions based on ongoing clinical-phase results. In the interim, Congo’s health authorities maintain core measures: case surveillance, isolation, contact tracing, and health education, alongside providing frontline workers with necessary equipment. The report from Kinshasa underscores vaccine development as part of the broader public health response in the DRC as of 2026-10-26.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ対策の新ワクチン試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラワクチン臨床試験開始の報であり、現時点で新規症例急増等の異常事態を示す情報はないが、エボラは重大疾患であり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験開始の報道であり、現行のエボラ流行状況や症例数についての具体的情報は含まれていない。
